examples.en: She experienced a skid on the moist surface and almost tumbled.
examples.zh: 她在湿地板上滑了一下差点摔倒。

basic_explanation: 用 go down a slope 替代 descend/decline/incline。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 slope 是地形基础名词。
ogden_principle: slope 是地理描述的基础名词。go down a slope = descend，用核心动词 + 名词替代单一动词。

examples.en: The children went down the grass slope on boards.
examples.zh: 孩子们踩着滑板从草坡上滑下来。

examples.en: The youngsters descended the grassy incline on planks.
examples.zh: 孩子们踩着滑板从草坡上滑下来。

basic_explanation: 用 give a smash 替代 smash/shatter/crush/destroy。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 smash 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: smash 体现了名词化。give a smash = smash，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The plate fell and was broken with a loud smash.
examples.zh: 盘子掉下来哗啦一声碎了。

examples.en: The dish descended and shattered with a resounding crash.
examples.zh: 盘子掉下来哗啦一声碎了。

basic_explanation: 用 have a smell of 替代 smell/sniff/whiff。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 smell 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: smell 体现了名词化。have a smell of = smell，用 have + 名词 + of 替代动词。

examples.en: There is a sweet smell of flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 花园里有一股甜美的花香。

examples.en: A fragrant aroma of blossoms permeates the garden.
examples.zh: 花园里有一股甜美的花香。

basic_explanation: 用 give a smile 替代 smile/grin/beam。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 smile 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: smile 体现了名词化。give a smile = smile，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She gave a warm smile to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她对房间里的每个人都报以温暖的微笑。

examples.en: She beamed warmly at all occupants of the chamber.
examples.zh: 她对房间里的每个人都报以温暖的微笑。

basic_explanation: 用 give off smoke 替代 smoke/emit fumes。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 smoke 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: smoke 体现了名词化。give off smoke = smoke，用 give + off + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Smoke was coming out of the top of the old house.
examples.zh: 老房子的屋顶上冒出烟来。

examples.en: Fumes were emanating from the roof of the antiquated dwelling.
examples.zh: 老房子的屋顶上冒出烟来。

basic_explanation: 用 give a sneeze 替代 sneeze。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sneeze 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: sneeze 体现了名词化。give a sneeze = sneeze，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He gave a loud sneeze in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 他在安静的房间里打了个响亮的喷嚏。

examples.en: He emitted a resonant sternutation in the tranquil chamber.
examples.zh: 他在安静的房间里打了个响亮的喷嚏。

basic_explanation: 用 have snow 替代 snow/ snowfall。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 snow 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: snow 体现了名词化。have snow = snow，用 have + 名词替代天气动词。

examples.en: We had deep snow all through the cold winter.
examples.zh: 整个寒冬我们这儿雪积得很深。

examples.en: We experienced substantial snowfall throughout the frigid winter season.
examples.zh: 整个寒冬我们这儿雪积得很深。

basic_explanation: 用 soap 替代 cleanser/detergent。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 soap 是日用品基础名词。
ogden_principle: soap 入选因为它是日常清洁的基础用品。Basic English 保留这类核心日用品名词。

examples.en: Wash your hands well with soap and water before you eat.
examples.zh: 吃饭前用肥皂和水好好洗手。

examples.en: Cleanse your hands thoroughly with cleansing agent and water prior to dining.
examples.zh: 吃饭前用肥皂和水好好洗手。

basic_explanation: 用 society 替代 community/the public/social order。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 society 是最通用的社会组织词。
ogden_principle: society 是社会学基础名词。Basic English 用它覆盖所有人类集体概念。

examples.en: We all have a part to play in a good society.
examples.zh: 在一个良好的社会中我们都有自己的角色。

examples.en: We each have a role to fulfill in a functional community.
examples.zh: 在一个良好的社会中我们都有自己的角色。

basic_explanation: 用 son 替代 male child/offspring。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 son 是基础亲属词。
ogden_principle: son 是最基础的亲属关系名词。Basic English 保留核心亲属词汇。

examples.en: My son is ten years old and loves to read books.
examples.zh: 我儿子十岁了，很喜欢读书。

examples.en: My male offspring is a decade of age and adores reading literature.
examples.zh: 我儿子十岁了，很喜欢读书。

basic_explanation: 用 give a song 替代 sing/perform vocally。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 song 是名词，sing 是动词。
ogden_principle: song 体现了名词化。give a song = sing，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She gave a beautiful song at the school show.
examples.zh: 她在学校演出中唱了一首优美的歌曲。

examples.en: She performed a melodious vocal piece at the school presentation.
examples.zh: 她在学校演出中唱了一首优美的歌曲。

basic_explanation: 用 put into sorts 替代 sort/categorize/classify。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sort 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: sort 体现了名词化。put into sorts = sort/classify，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the letters into different sorts by date.
examples.zh: 按日期把信件分类整理。

examples.en: Categorize the correspondence into distinct classifications chronologically.
examples.zh: 按日期把信件分类整理。

basic_explanation: 用 make a sound 替代 sound/emit noise。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sound 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: sound 体现了名词化。make a sound = sound，用 make + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: I heard a strange sound coming from the other room.
examples.zh: 我听到另一个房间传来奇怪的声音。

examples.en: I perceived an unusual acoustic emission from the adjacent chamber.
examples.zh: 我听到另一个房间传来奇怪的声音。

basic_explanation: 用 have soup 替代 eat soup/consume broth。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 soup 是基础食物名词。
ogden_principle: soup 入选因为它是最常见的食物类型之一。Basic English 保留这类核心饮食名词。

examples.en: We had hot soup with bread for our evening meal.
examples.zh: 我们晚餐喝了热汤配面包。

examples.en: We consumed heated broth with baked dough for our evening repast.
examples.zh: 我们晚餐喝了热汤配面包。

basic_explanation: 用 make space for 替代 create room/accommodate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 space 可指空间或太空。
ogden_principle: space 体现了名词化。make space for = accommodate，用 make + 名词 + for 替代动词。

examples.en: Is there enough space for another bed in the room?
examples.zh: 房间里还有足够空间再放一张床吗？

examples.en: Is there sufficient capacity for an additional bed in the chamber?
examples.zh: 房间里还有足够空间再放一张床吗？

basic_explanation: 用 go on stage 替代 perform/appear before audience。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stage 可指舞台或阶段。
ogden_principle: stage 是一个多义名词。go on stage = perform，用核心动词 + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She went on the stage for the first time last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚第一次登上了舞台。

examples.en: She made her theatrical debut last evening.
examples.zh: 她昨晚第一次登上了舞台。

basic_explanation: 用 make a start 替代 start/begin/commence。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 start 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: start 体现了名词化。make a start = start/begin，用 make + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Let us make an early start in the morning before sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们日出前一大早就出发吧。

examples.en: Let us commence early in the morning prior to dawn.
examples.zh: 我们日出前一大早就出发吧。

basic_explanation: 用 make a statement 替代 state/declare/announce。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 statement 是名词，state 是动词。
ogden_principle: statement 体现了名词化。make a statement = state/declare，用 make + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He made a short statement to the police about the crime.
examples.zh: 他向警方就该罪行做了一个简短陈述。

examples.en: He provided a brief declaration to law enforcement regarding the offense.
examples.zh: 他向警方就该罪行做了一个简短陈述。

basic_explanation: 用 give off steam 替代 steam/emit vapor。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 steam 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: steam 体现了名词化。give off steam = steam，用 give + off + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Steam was coming up from the hot cup of coffee.
examples.zh: 热咖啡杯上冒出蒸汽。

examples.en: Vapor was rising from the heated receptacle of coffee.
examples.zh: 热咖啡杯上冒出蒸汽。

basic_explanation: 用 made of steel 替代 steel/metal alloy。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 steel 是基础工业材料名词。
ogden_principle: steel 入选因为它是现代工业最重要的材料之一。Basic English 保留这类核心物质名词。

examples.en: The great bridge is made of steel and stone.
examples.zh: 那座大桥是钢筋和石头建成的。

examples.en: The grand viaduct is constructed of ferrous alloy and masonry.
examples.zh: 那座大桥是钢筋和石头建成的。

basic_explanation: 用 take a step 替代 step/move/proceed。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 step 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: step 体现了名词化。take a step = step/move，用 take + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Take one small step forward and then stop.
examples.zh: 向前迈一小步然后停下来。

examples.en: Advance incrementally forward and then halt.
examples.zh: 向前迈一小步然后停下来。

basic_explanation: 用 a stick 替代 branch/rod/cane/walking stick。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stick 是日常物品名词。
ogden_principle: stick 入选因为它是最基础的长条形物体概念。Basic English 用它覆盖拐杖、树枝、棒状物等。

examples.en: The old man used a stick to help him walk.
examples.zh: 老人拄着拐杖走路。

examples.en: The elderly gentleman utilized a cane to assist his ambulation.
examples.zh: 老人拄着拐杖走路。

basic_explanation: 用 put a stitch in 替代 stitch/sew/mend。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stitch 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: stitch 体现了名词化。put a stitch in = stitch/sew，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: She put a few stitches in the hole in the cloth.
examples.zh: 她在布上的破洞里缝了几针。

examples.en: She applied several sutures to the aperture in the fabric.
examples.zh: 她在布上的破洞里缝了几针。

basic_explanation: 用 made of stone 替代 stone/rock/mineral。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stone 是基础物质名词。
ogden_principle: stone 是最基础的自然材料名词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: The old wall around the field is made of stone.
examples.zh: 田边那堵旧墙是石头砌的。

examples.en: The ancient barrier surrounding the field is constructed of rock.
examples.zh: 田边那堵旧墙是石头砌的。

basic_explanation: 用 come to a stop 替代 stop/halt/cease。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stop 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: stop 体现了名词化。come to a stop = stop，用核心动词 come + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The bus came to a stop at the side of the road.
examples.zh: 公交车在路边停了下来。

examples.en: The omnibus halted at the roadside.
examples.zh: 公交车在路边停了下来。

basic_explanation: 用 give a story 替代 tell a story/narrate/recount。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 story 是名词，narrate 是动词。
ogden_principle: story 体现了名词化。give a story = tell/narrate，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Please give the children a story before they go to sleep.
examples.zh: 请在孩子们睡觉前给他们讲个故事。

examples.en: Please narrate a tale to the youngsters prior to their slumber.
examples.zh: 请在孩子们睡觉前给他们讲个故事。

basic_explanation: 用 give a stretch 替代 stretch/extend/elongate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stretch 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: stretch 体现了名词化。give a stretch = stretch，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give your arms and legs a good stretch in the morning.
examples.zh: 早上好好伸展一下你的胳膊和腿。

examples.en: Perform a thorough extension of your limbs in the morning.
examples.zh: 早上好好伸展一下你的胳膊和腿。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a structure 替代 build/construct/erect。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 structure 是名词，build 是动词。
ogden_principle: structure 体现了名词化。put up a structure = build/construct，用 put + up + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: They put up a strong structure made of steel and glass.
examples.zh: 他们建起了一座钢铁和玻璃构成的坚固建筑。

examples.en: They erected a robust edifice composed of ferrous metal and vitreous material.
examples.zh: 他们建起了一座钢铁和玻璃构成的坚固建筑。

basic_explanation: 用 substance 替代 material/matter/essence。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 substance 是物理学和哲学基础名词。
ogden_principle: substance 入选因为它覆盖了物质和本质两个核心概念。Basic English 用一词多义策略减少词汇量。

examples.en: Water is a liquid substance that has no color.
examples.zh: 水是一种无色的液体物质。

examples.en: Water constitutes a transparent fluid material.
examples.zh: 水是一种无色的液体物质。

basic_explanation: 用 put sugar in 替代 sugar/sweeten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sugar 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: sugar 体现了名词化。put sugar in = sugar/sweeten，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Do you put sugar in your coffee in the morning?
examples.zh: 你早上喝咖啡加糖吗？

examples.en: Do you sweeten your morning coffee with saccharine?
examples.zh: 你早上喝咖啡加糖吗？

basic_explanation: 用 make a suggestion 替代 suggest/propose/recommend。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 suggestion 是名词，suggest 是动词。
ogden_principle: suggestion 体现了名词化。make a suggestion = suggest，用 make + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: May I make a suggestion about the new work plan?
examples.zh: 我可以就新的工作计划提个建议吗？

examples.en: May I offer a proposition regarding the new operational strategy?
examples.zh: 我可以就新的工作计划提个建议吗？

basic_explanation: 用 in the summer 替代 during summer/estival period。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 summer 是最基础的季节词。
ogden_principle: summer 是不可替代的季节名词。Basic English 保留这类核心时间概念词。

examples.en: We go to the sea every summer for a long holiday.
examples.zh: 我们每年夏天都去海边度长假。

examples.en: We travel to the coast each estival season for an extended vacation.
examples.zh: 我们每年夏天都去海边度长假。

basic_explanation: 用 give support to 替代 support/back/endorse/uphold。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 support 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: support 体现了名词化。give support to = support，用 give + 名词 + to 替代及物动词。

examples.en: She gave her full support to the new education plan.
examples.zh: 她全力支持新的教育计划。

examples.en: She provided her complete endorsement to the novel educational initiative.
examples.zh: 她全力支持新的教育计划。

basic_explanation: 用 give a surprise to 替代 surprise/astonish/amaze。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 surprise 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: surprise 体现了名词化。give a surprise to = surprise，用 give + 名词 + to 替代及物动词。

examples.en: They gave her a great surprise on her birthday.
examples.zh: 他们在她生日那天给了她一个大惊喜。

examples.en: They astonished her tremendously on her natal anniversary.
examples.zh: 他们在她生日那天给了她一个大惊喜。

basic_explanation: 用 go for a swim 替代 swim/bathe。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 swim 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: swim 体现了名词化。go for a swim = swim，用核心动词 go + for + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Let us go for a swim in the cool river water.
examples.zh: 我们去清凉的河水中游泳吧。

examples.en: Let us bathe in the refreshing river waters.
examples.zh: 我们去清凉的河水中游泳吧。

basic_explanation: 用 put into a system 替代 systematize/organize/structure。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 system 是名词，systematize 是动词。
ogden_principle: system 体现了名词化。put into a system = systematize，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We need to put the office work into a better system.
examples.zh: 我们需要把办公室工作整理成一个更好的系统。

examples.en: We must organize the administrative tasks into a more efficient structure.
examples.zh: 我们需要把办公室工作整理成一个更好的系统。

basic_explanation: 用 have a talk 替代 talk/speak/discuss/converse。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 talk 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: talk 体现了名词化。have a talk = talk/discuss，用 have + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We had a long talk about our plans for the future.
examples.zh: 我们就未来的计划进行了长谈。

examples.en: We engaged in an extended discussion regarding our future plans.
examples.zh: 我们就未来的计划进行了长谈。

basic_explanation: 用 have a taste of 替代 taste/sample/savor。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 taste 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: taste 体现了名词化。have a taste of = taste，用 have + 名词 + of 替代动词。

examples.en: Have a taste of this soup and tell me what you think.
examples.zh: 尝尝这汤，告诉我你觉得怎么样。

examples.en: Sample this broth and provide your assessment.
examples.zh: 尝尝这汤，告诉我你觉得怎么样。

basic_explanation: 用 put a tax on 替代 tax/levy/impose。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tax 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: tax 体现了名词化。put a tax on = tax/levy，用 put + 名词 + on 替代及物动词。

examples.en: The government put a new tax on goods from other countries.
examples.zh: 政府对来自其他国家的商品征收了新税。

examples.en: The administration imposed a new levy on imported merchandise.
examples.zh: 政府对来自其他国家的商品征收了新税。

basic_explanation: 用 give teaching to 替代 teach/instruct/educate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 teaching 是名词，teach 是动词。
ogden_principle: teaching 体现了名词化。give teaching to = teach，用 give + 名词 + to 替代及物动词。

examples.en: She gave good teaching to the young children at the school.
examples.zh: 她在学校给幼儿提供了良好的教学。

examples.en: She provided excellent instruction to the young pupils at the institution.
examples.zh: 她在学校给幼儿提供了良好的教学。

basic_explanation: 用 have a tendency to 替代 tend/incline/be prone to。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tendency 是名词，tend 是动词。
ogden_principle: tendency 体现了名词化。have a tendency to = tend to，用 have + 名词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: He has a tendency to be late for morning meetings.
examples.zh: 他有早上开会迟到的倾向。

examples.en: He is inclined to arrive tardily for morning conferences.
examples.zh: 他有早上开会迟到的倾向。

basic_explanation: 用 put to the test 替代 test/examine/evaluate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 test 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: test 体现了名词化。put to the test = test/evaluate，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The hard climb put his strength to the test.
examples.zh: 艰难的攀登考验了他的体力。

examples.en: The arduous ascent examined his physical fortitude.
examples.zh: 艰难的攀登考验了他的体力。

basic_explanation: 用 put forward a theory 替代 theorize/hypothesize/speculate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 theory 是名词，theorize 是动词。
ogden_principle: theory 体现了名词化。put forward a theory = theorize，用 put + forward + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He put forward a new theory about how the earth was formed.
examples.zh: 他提出了一个关于地球如何形成的新理论。

examples.en: He proposed a novel hypothesis regarding the formation of the planet.
examples.zh: 他提出了一个关于地球如何形成的新理论。

basic_explanation: 用 thing 替代 object/item/entity/matter。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 thing 是最通用的物体概念词。
ogden_principle: thing 是 Basic English 中功能最强大的名词之一，可以替代几乎所有具体和抽象的名词。这是 Ogden 词汇极简化的核心体现。

examples.en: What is that strange thing on the table over there?
examples.zh: 那边桌子上那个奇怪的东西是什么？

examples.en: What is that peculiar object on the surface over yonder?
examples.zh: 那边桌子上那个奇怪的东西是什么？

basic_explanation: 用 give thought to 替代 think/consider/ponder/reflect。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 thought 是名词，think 是动词。
ogden_principle: thought 体现了名词化。give thought to = think/consider，用 give + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Please give some thought to what I have said today.
examples.zh: 请想想我今天说的话。

examples.en: Please reflect upon what I have articulated today.
examples.zh: 请想想我今天说的话。

basic_explanation: 用 have thunder 替代 thunder/lightning storm。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 thunder 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: thunder 体现了名词化。have thunder = thunder，用 have + 名词替代天气动词。

examples.en: We had loud thunder and rain all through the night.
examples.zh: 雷声响亮，雨下了整整一夜。

examples.en: We experienced resonant thunderclaps and precipitation throughout the nocturnal hours.
examples.zh: 雷声响亮，雨下了整整一夜。

basic_explanation: 用 have time for 替代 have opportunity/leisure for。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 time 是最基础的概念词。
ogden_principle: time 是不可替代的基础概念名词。Basic English 用它覆盖所有时间相关表达。

examples.en: Do you have time for a quick talk before you go?
examples.zh: 你走之前有时间快速聊一下吗？

examples.en: Do you possess a moment for a brief discussion prior to your departure?
examples.zh: 你走之前有时间快速聊一下吗？

basic_explanation: 用 tin 替代 can/tinplate/metal container。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tin 可指锡金属或罐头。
ogden_principle: tin 是一个多义名词，覆盖金属材料和食品容器两个语义域。Basic English 用一词多义策略减少词汇量。

examples.en: Open a tin of beans for our meal tonight.
examples.zh: 开一罐豆子当我们今晚的晚餐。

examples.en: Open a can of legumes for our repast this evening.
examples.zh: 开一罐豆子当我们今晚的晚餐。

basic_explanation: 用 on top of 替代 atop/above/on the highest point。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 top 是空间定位基础词。
ogden_principle: top 是空间概念的基础名词。on top of = atop/above，用介词短语替代复杂介词。

examples.en: Put the book on top of the others on the shelf.
examples.zh: 把这本书放在书架上其他书的上面。

examples.en: Place the volume atop the others on the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 把这本书放在书架上其他书的上面。

basic_explanation: 用 give a touch 替代 touch/contact/feel。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 touch 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: touch 体现了名词化。give a touch = touch，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: A gentle touch on the hand made her feel better.
examples.zh: 在手上轻轻一碰让她感觉好多了。

examples.en: A delicate tactile contact on the manus improved her disposition.
examples.zh: 在手上轻轻一碰让她感觉好多了。

basic_explanation: 用 do trade with 替代 trade/barter/exchange goods。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 trade 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: trade 体现了名词化。do trade with = trade，用 do + 名词 + with 替代动词。

examples.en: The two countries do trade with one another in food and oil.
examples.zh: 两国在食品和石油方面进行贸易。

examples.en: The two nations engage in commerce with each other in provisions and petroleum.
examples.zh: 两国在食品和石油方面进行贸易。

basic_explanation: 用 give transport to 替代 transport/carry/convey/ship。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 transport 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: transport 体现了名词化。give transport to = transport，用 give + 名词 + to 替代及物动词。

examples.en: The train gives quick transport between the two cities.
examples.zh: 火车提供了两座城市之间的快速交通。

examples.en: The railway provides rapid transportation between the two metropolises.
examples.zh: 火车提供了两座城市之间的快速交通。

basic_explanation: 用 play a trick on 替代 trick/deceive/fool。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 trick 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: trick 体现了名词化。play a trick on = trick/deceive，用 play + 名词 + on 替代及物动词。

examples.en: The boys played a friendly trick on their teacher.
examples.zh: 男孩们对老师搞了一个友好的恶作剧。

examples.en: The youths perpetrated an amicable prank on their instructor.
examples.zh: 男孩们对老师搞了一个友好的恶作剧。

basic_explanation: 用 have trouble with 替代 struggle/have difficulty with。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 trouble 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: trouble 体现了名词化。have trouble with = struggle with，用 have + 名词 + with 替代动词短语。

examples.en: I am having trouble getting the car to start this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我发动不了汽车了。

examples.en: I am experiencing difficulty igniting the automobile this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我发动不了汽车了。

basic_explanation: 用 take a turn 替代 rotate/alternate/take turns。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 turn 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: turn 体现了名词化。take a turn = rotate/alternate，用 take + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: It is your turn to do the washing up tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚轮到你洗碗了。

examples.en: It is your rotation to perform the dish cleansing this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚轮到你洗碗了。

basic_explanation: 用 give a twist 替代 twist/wring/contort。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 twist 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: twist 体现了名词化。give a twist = twist，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give the top a hard twist to get it off the bottle.
examples.zh: 用力拧瓶盖把它从瓶子上取下来。

examples.en: Apply a forceful torsion to the cap to remove it from the receptacle.
examples.zh: 用力拧瓶盖把它从瓶子上取下来。

basic_explanation: 用 unit 替代 single entity/module/component。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 unit 是数学和工程基础名词。
ogden_principle: unit 入选因为它覆盖了度量、组织和模块化概念。Basic English 用它替代多个细化词。

examples.en: A meter is a unit for measuring how long something is.
examples.zh: 米是度量长度的单位。

examples.en: A meter constitutes a measurement module for quantifying spatial extension.
examples.zh: 米是度量长度的单位。

basic_explanation: 用 make use of 替代 use/utilize/employ。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 use 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: use 体现了名词化。make use of = use/utilize，用 make + 名词 + of 替代及物动词。这是 Basic English 最经典的表达之一。

examples.en: We should make good use of the time we have together.
examples.zh: 我们应该好好利用我们在一起的时间。

examples.en: We ought to utilize effectively the time we share together.
examples.zh: 我们应该好好利用我们在一起的时间。

basic_explanation: 用 put a value on 替代 value/evaluate/appraise/assess。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 value 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: value 体现了名词化。put a value on = value/evaluate，用 put + 名词 + on 替代及物动词。

examples.en: It is hard to put a value on such a beautiful work of art.
examples.zh: 很难给这样一件美丽的艺术品估价。

examples.en: It is difficult to appraise such an exquisite work of artistry.
examples.zh: 很难给这样一件美丽的艺术品估价。

basic_explanation: 用 put into verse 替代 versify/compose poetry。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 verse 是文学体裁名词。
ogden_principle: verse 体现了名词化。put into verse = versify，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She put her deep feelings into beautiful verse.
examples.zh: 她把深切的感受写成了美丽的诗句。

examples.en: She expressed her profound emotions through exquisite poetry.
examples.zh: 她把深切的感受写成了美丽的诗句。

basic_explanation: 用 vessel 替代 ship/container/receptacle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 vessel 可指船只或容器。
ogden_principle: vessel 是一个多义名词，覆盖航海交通工具和盛装容器两个语义域。Basic English 用一词多义策略减少词汇量。

examples.en: The great vessel went across the sea in five days.
examples.zh: 那艘大船五天就横渡了大海。

examples.en: The grand maritime craft traversed the ocean in five solar cycles.
examples.zh: 那艘大船五天就横渡了大海。

basic_explanation: 用 have a view of 替代 see/view/observe/regard。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 view 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: view 体现了名词化。have a view of = view/see，用 have + 名词 + of 替代动词。

examples.en: We had a beautiful view of the mountains from our room.
examples.zh: 从我们房间可以看到美丽的山景。

examples.en: We enjoyed a picturesque panorama of the peaks from our chamber.
examples.zh: 从我们房间可以看到美丽的山景。

basic_explanation: 用 give voice to 替代 voice/express/articulate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 voice 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: voice 体现了名词化。give voice to = voice/express，用 give + 名词 + to 替代及物动词。

examples.en: She gave voice to the feelings of everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她表达了房间里每个人的感受。

examples.en: She articulated the sentiments of all occupants in the chamber.
examples.zh: 她表达了房间里每个人的感受。

basic_explanation: 用 go for a walk 替代 walk/stroll/hike。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 walk 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: walk 体现了名词化。go for a walk = walk，用核心动词 go + for + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Let us go for a short walk in the park after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我们去公园里散个步吧。

examples.en: Let us take a brief stroll in the park after the midday meal.
examples.zh: 午饭后我们去公园里散个步吧。

basic_explanation: 用 go to war 替代 wage war/fight/battle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 war 是名词，wage war 是动词短语。
ogden_principle: war 体现了名词化。go to war = wage war，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代复杂动词结构。

examples.en: No one wants to go to war if peace is possible.
examples.zh: 如果可以和平，没有人想打仗。

examples.en: Nobody desires armed conflict if tranquility is attainable.
examples.zh: 如果可以和平，没有人想打仗。

basic_explanation: 用 give a wash 替代 wash/cleanse/launder。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wash 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wash 体现了名词化。give a wash = wash，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give the car a good wash before our trip tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天出行前把车好好洗一下。

examples.en: Thoroughly launder the automobile prior to our journey tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天出行前把车好好洗一下。

basic_explanation: 用 go to waste 替代 be wasted/unused/squandered。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 waste 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: waste 体现了名词化。go to waste = be wasted，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代被动结构。

examples.en: Do not let good food go to waste when others are hungry.
examples.zh: 当别人在挨饿时不要浪费好食物。

examples.en: Do not allow nutritious provisions to be squandered while others experience hunger.
examples.zh: 当别人在挨饿时不要浪费好食物。

basic_explanation: 用 give water to 替代 water/irrigate/hydrate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 water 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: water 体现了名词化。give water to = water/irrigate，用 give + 名词 + to 替代及物动词。

examples.en: Please give some water to the dry plants in the garden.
examples.zh: 请给花园里干枯的植物浇点水。

examples.en: Please irrigate the desiccated vegetation in the garden.
examples.zh: 请给花园里干枯的植物浇点水。

basic_explanation: 用 give a wave 替代 wave/undulate/gesture。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wave 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wave 体现了名词化。give a wave = wave，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give a wave to your friends as the train goes out.
examples.zh: 火车开出去时跟你的朋友们挥挥手。

examples.en: Gesture farewell to your companions as the locomotive departs.
examples.zh: 火车开出去时跟你的朋友们挥挥手。

basic_explanation: 用 put wax on 替代 wax/polish/seal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wax 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wax 体现了名词化。put wax on = wax/polish，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Put some wax on the table to make it shine bright.
examples.zh: 给桌子上点蜡让它发亮。

examples.en: Apply polishing substance to the table to enhance its luster.
examples.zh: 给桌子上点蜡让它发亮。

basic_explanation: 用 way 替代 method/path/route/means。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 way 是最通用的方式词。
ogden_principle: way 是 Basic English 中功能极强的名词，覆盖方法、路径、方向等多个语义域。这是词汇极简化的核心体现。

examples.en: Is there a better way to get this work done quickly?
examples.zh: 有没有更好的办法快速完成这项工作？

examples.en: Is there a more efficient methodology to complete this task rapidly?
examples.zh: 有没有更好的办法快速完成这项工作？

basic_explanation: 用 have good weather 替代 be sunny/pleasant/fair。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 weather 是不可替代的自然概念词。
ogden_principle: weather 是不可替代的基础概念名词。Basic English 保留这类核心词。

examples.en: We had beautiful weather for our holiday by the sea.
examples.zh: 我们在海边度假时天气非常好。

examples.en: We enjoyed splendid meteorological conditions during our seaside vacation.
examples.zh: 我们在海边度假时天气非常好。

basic_explanation: 用 a week 替代 seven days/weekly period。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 week 是不可替代的时间单位。
ogden_principle: week 是不可替代的时间度量名词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: There are seven days in one week, no more and no less.
examples.zh: 一周有七天，不多不少。

examples.en: A single week comprises precisely seven solar cycles.
examples.zh: 一周有七天，不多不少。

basic_explanation: 用 have a weight of 替代 weigh/be heavy。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 weight 是名词，weigh 是动词。
ogden_principle: weight 体现了名词化。have a weight of = weigh，用 have + 名词 + of 替代动词。

examples.en: What is the weight of this box of books?
examples.zh: 这箱书有多重？

examples.en: What is the mass of this carton of volumes?
examples.zh: 这箱书有多重？

basic_explanation: 用 have a strong wind 替代 be windy/gusty。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wind 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wind 体现了名词化。have a strong wind = be windy，用 have + 名词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: We had a cold north wind all through the night.
examples.zh: 整夜都刮着寒冷的北风。

examples.en: We experienced frigid northerly gusts throughout the nocturnal period.
examples.zh: 整夜都刮着寒冷的北风。

basic_explanation: 用 have wine with 替代 drink wine/accompany with wine。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wine 是饮食文化基础名词。
ogden_principle: wine 入选因为它是最具文化意义的饮品之一。Basic English 保留这类核心饮食名词。

examples.en: They had red wine with their evening meal together.
examples.zh: 他们晚餐时一起喝了红葡萄酒。

examples.en: They consumed claret with their evening repast together.
examples.zh: 他们晚餐时一起喝了红葡萄酒。

basic_explanation: 用 in the winter 替代 during winter/hibernal season。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 winter 是最基础的季节词。
ogden_principle: winter 是不可替代的季节名词。Basic English 保留这类核心时间概念词。

examples.en: The days are short and cold in the deep winter months.
examples.zh: 在深冬月份里白天又短又冷。

examples.en: The diurnal periods are brief and frigid during the hibernal season.
examples.zh: 在深冬月份里白天又短又冷。

basic_explanation: 用 woman 替代 female/lady/adult female。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 woman 是最基础的性别词。
ogden_principle: woman 是不可替代的基础社会名词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: A young woman came into the store looking for a book.
examples.zh: 一位年轻女士走进书店来找一本书。

examples.en: A youthful female entered the establishment seeking a volume.
examples.zh: 一位年轻女士走进书店来找一本书。

basic_explanation: 用 made of wood 替代 wooden/timber。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wood 是基础材料名词。
ogden_principle: wood 是最基础的自然材料名词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: The table is made of dark wood from the forest.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是用森林里的深色木材制成的。

examples.en: The furnishing is crafted from dark timber sourced from the woodland.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是用森林里的深色木材制成的。

basic_explanation: 用 made of wool 替代 woolen/fleece。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wool 是基础纺织材料名词。
ogden_principle: wool 入选因为它是最重要的天然纤维之一。Basic English 保留这类核心材料名词。

examples.en: She wore a warm coat made of soft sheep wool.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件柔软的羊毛保暖外套。

examples.en: She donned a thermal garment crafted from soft ovine fleece.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件柔软的羊毛保暖外套。

basic_explanation: 用 give your word 替代 promise/pledge/vow。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 word 可指单词或承诺。
ogden_principle: word 体现了名词化。give your word = promise，用 give + 名词替代动词。同时覆盖语言单位概念。

examples.en: I give you my word that I will be there on time.
examples.zh: 我向你保证我会准时到。

examples.en: I pledge my solemn oath that I shall arrive punctually.
examples.zh: 我向你保证我会准时到。

basic_explanation: 用 do work 替代 work/labor/toil。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 work 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: work 体现了名词化。do work = work，用 do + 名词替代动词。这是 Basic English 最基础的表达之一。

examples.en: He did good work today and finished early.
examples.zh: 他今天工作做得很好，早早就完成了。

examples.en: He performed his occupational duties excellently today and completed them ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 他今天工作做得很好，早早就完成了。

basic_explanation: 用 at an angle 替代 angled/slanted/oblique。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 angle 是几何基础名词。
ogden_principle: angle 体现了名词化。at an angle = angled，用介词 + 名词替代形容词。

examples.en: The board was put at a sharp angle against the wall.
examples.zh: 木板以一个锐角斜靠在墙上。

examples.en: The plank was positioned at an acute inclination against the partition.
examples.zh: 木板以一个锐角斜靠在墙上。

basic_explanation: 用 ant 替代 small insect/colonial insect。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ant 是常见昆虫名词。
ogden_principle: ant 入选因为它是日常生活中最常见的小生物之一。Basic English 保留这类可图示的具体名词。

examples.en: A line of ants was going across the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 一队蚂蚁正穿过厨房地板。

examples.en: A procession of formicidae was traversing the culinary surface.
examples.zh: 一队蚂蚁正穿过厨房地板。

basic_explanation: 用 apple 替代 common fruit/orchard fruit。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 apple 是最基础的水果名词。
ogden_principle: apple 入选因为它是全球最普遍的水果之一。Basic English 保留这类可图示的核心食物名词。

examples.en: I take an apple with me to work every day.
examples.zh: 我每天带一个苹果去上班。

examples.en: I bring a pomaceous fruit with me to my occupation daily.
examples.zh: 我每天带一个苹果去上班。

basic_explanation: 用 go under an arch 替代 pass through an archway。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 arch 是建筑基础名词。
ogden_principle: arch 入选因为它是经典的建筑结构形式。Basic English 保留这类可图示的具体名词。

examples.en: We went under the old stone arch into the garden.
examples.zh: 我们从古老的石拱门下走进花园。

examples.en: We passed beneath the ancient masonry arcade into the garden.
examples.zh: 我们从古老的石拱门下走进花园。

basic_explanation: 用 give an arm to 替代 help/assist/lend a hand。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 arm 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: arm 体现了名词化。give an arm to = help，用 give + 名词 + to 表达帮助。

examples.en: He broke his left arm in a fall from the tree.
examples.zh: 他从树上摔下来折断了左臂。

examples.en: He fractured his left upper limb in a descent from the arboreal specimen.
examples.zh: 他从树上摔下来折断了左臂。

basic_explanation: 用 go into the army 替代 enlist/join the military。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 army 是军事基础名词。
ogden_principle: army 体现了名词化。go into the army = enlist，用核心动词 go + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He went into the army when he was a young man.
examples.zh: 他年轻时参了军。

examples.en: He enlisted in the military forces during his youth.
examples.zh: 他年轻时参了军。

basic_explanation: 用 have a baby 替代 give birth/bear a child。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 baby 是基础生命阶段名词。
ogden_principle: baby 体现了名词化。have a baby = give birth，用 have + 名词替代复杂动词结构。

examples.en: The baby is sleeping quietly in the small bed.
examples.zh: 宝宝在小床上安静地睡着。

examples.en: The infant is slumbering peacefully in the diminutive cot.
examples.zh: 宝宝在小床上安静地睡着。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a bag 替代 bag/pack/sack。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bag 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: bag 体现了名词化。put in a bag = bag/pack，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put your things in a bag and come with us.
examples.zh: 把你的东西装进包里跟我们走。

examples.en: Pack your belongings into a satchel and accompany us.
examples.zh: 把你的东西装进包里跟我们走。

basic_explanation: 用 give a ball 替代 throw/hurl/toss。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ball 可指球形物体或舞会。
ogden_principle: ball 体现了名词化。give a ball = throw，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give the ball to me and I will try to get it in the net.
examples.zh: 把球给我，我试试投进网里。

examples.en: Pass the sphere to me and I shall attempt to score.
examples.zh: 把球给我，我试试投进网里。

basic_explanation: 用 put a band round 替代 band/bind/encircle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 band 可指带状物或乐队。
ogden_principle: band 体现了名词化。put a band round = band/bind，用 put + 名词 + round 替代动词。

examples.en: She put a red band round her hair to keep it back.
examples.zh: 她用一根红色发带把头发束在后面。

examples.en: She secured her tresses with a crimson circlet to keep them back.
examples.zh: 她用一根红色发带把头发束在后面。

basic_explanation: 用 basin 替代 washbowl/sink/container。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 basin 是日常用品名词。
ogden_principle: basin 入选因为它是家庭生活中的基础容器。Basic English 保留这类可图示的具体名词。

examples.en: Fill the basin with warm water to wash your face.
examples.zh: 往水盆里倒温水来洗脸。

examples.en: Fill the washbowl with heated water to cleanse your visage.
examples.zh: 往水盆里倒温水来洗脸。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a basket 替代 collect in a basket。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 basket 是日常容器名词。
ogden_principle: basket 体现了名词化。put in a basket = collect，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She put all the apples in a basket to take to market.
examples.zh: 她把所有苹果放进篮子里带去市场。

examples.en: She collected all the pomaceous fruits into a wicker receptacle for the marketplace.
examples.zh: 她把所有苹果放进篮子里带去市场。

basic_explanation: 用 have a bath 替代 bathe/wash oneself。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bath 是名词，bathe 是动词。
ogden_principle: bath 体现了名词化。have a bath = bathe，用 have + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: I have a warm bath every night before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我每晚睡觉前都会洗个温水澡。

examples.en: I take a heated immersion every evening prior to retiring.
examples.zh: 我每晚睡觉前都会洗个温水澡。

basic_explanation: 用 go to bed 替代 retire/sleep/go to sleep。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bed 是家居基础名词。
ogden_principle: bed 体现了名词化。go to bed = retire/sleep，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The children go to bed at eight every night.
examples.zh: 孩子们每晚八点上床睡觉。

examples.en: The youngsters retire at eight each evening.
examples.zh: 孩子们每晚八点上床睡觉。

basic_explanation: 用 bee 替代 honeybee/pollinator。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bee 是常见昆虫名词。
ogden_principle: bee 入选因为它是自然界最重要的小生物之一。Basic English 保留这类可图示的具体名词。

examples.en: A bee was going from flower to flower in the garden.
examples.zh: 一只蜜蜂在花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

examples.en: A honeybee was flitting from blossom to blossom in the garden.
examples.zh: 一只蜜蜂在花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

basic_explanation: 用 give a ring on the bell 替代 ring/chime/peal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bell 是名词，ring 是动词。
ogden_principle: bell 体现了名词化。give a ring on the bell = ring，用 give + 名词 + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The bell on the church gave a loud ring at noon.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟在正午敲响了。

examples.en: The campanile emitted a resonant chime at midday.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟在正午敲响了。

basic_explanation: 用 go for berries 替代 pick berries/forage。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 berry 是水果类别名词。
ogden_principle: berry 体现了名词化。go for berries = pick berries，用核心动词 go + for + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We went into the woods to get wild berries in the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我们去树林里采野浆果。

examples.en: We ventured into the forest to gather wild berries during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我们去树林里采野浆果。

basic_explanation: 用 bird 替代 fowl/avian creature。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bird 是动物类别基础名词。
ogden_principle: bird 是生物学基础名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: A small brown bird was singing in the tree outside.
examples.zh: 一只棕色的小鸟在窗外的树上唱歌。

examples.en: A diminutive brown avian was warbling in the arboreal specimen outdoors.
examples.zh: 一只棕色的小鸟在窗外的树上唱歌。

basic_explanation: 用 blade 替代 cutting edge/leaf of grass。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 blade 可指刀刃或叶片。
ogden_principle: blade 是一个多义名词，覆盖刀具和植物两个语义域。Basic English 用一词多义策略减少词汇量。

examples.en: The blade of the knife is sharp and cuts well.
examples.zh: 刀刃很锋利，切起来很快。

examples.en: The cutting edge of the blade is honed and slices efficiently.
examples.zh: 刀刃很锋利，切起来很快。

basic_explanation: 用 put on the board 替代 display/post/present。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 board 可指木板或委员会。
ogden_principle: board 体现了名词化。put on the board = post/display，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the notice up on the board for everyone to see.
examples.zh: 把通知贴在布告栏上让大家看到。

examples.en: Post the announcement on the bulletin surface for universal visibility.
examples.zh: 把通知贴在布告栏上让大家看到。

basic_explanation: 用 go by boat 替代 sail/row/travel by water。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 boat 是水上交通工具名词。
ogden_principle: boat 体现了名词化。go by boat = sail，用核心动词 go + by + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We went out in a small boat on the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我们乘着小船在平静的湖面上出游。

examples.en: We ventured forth in a diminutive watercraft upon the tranquil lake.
examples.zh: 我们乘着小船在平静的湖面上出游。

basic_explanation: 用 bone 替代 skeletal element/osseous tissue。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bone 是身体结构基础名词。
ogden_principle: bone 是生物学基础名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The dog was chewing on a hard bone in the yard.
examples.zh: 狗在院子里啃着一根硬骨头。

examples.en: The canine was gnawing on a rigid osseous object in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 狗在院子里啃着一根硬骨头。

basic_explanation: 用 give a book to 替代 present a book/donate a volume。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 book 是文化基础名词。
ogden_principle: book 体现了名词化。give a book to = present a book，用 give + 名词 + to 替代复杂动词结构。

examples.en: She gave me a good book to read on the long train ride.
examples.zh: 她给了我一本书在长途火车上读。

examples.en: She presented me with an excellent volume to peruse during the extended railway journey.
examples.zh: 她给了我一本书在长途火车上读。

basic_explanation: 用 put on boots 替代 wear boots/don footwear。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 boot 是鞋类名词。
ogden_principle: boot 体现了名词化。put on boots = don boots，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on your strong boots before going out in the snow.
examples.zh: 出去雪地里之前穿上你的结实的靴子。

examples.en: Don your sturdy footwear prior to venturing into the snow.
examples.zh: 出去雪地里之前穿上你的结实的靴子。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a bottle 替代 bottle/preserve in glass。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bottle 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: bottle 体现了名词化。put in a bottle = bottle，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the fresh milk in a clean bottle and keep it cold.
examples.zh: 把新鲜牛奶倒进干净的瓶子里冷藏。

examples.en: Deposit the fresh dairy product into a sanitized container and maintain refrigeration.
examples.zh: 把新鲜牛奶倒进干净的瓶子里冷藏。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a box 替代 box/pack/crate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 box 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: box 体现了名词化。put in a box = box/pack，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put all the old books in a box and put it away.
examples.zh: 把所有旧书放进一个箱子里收起来。

examples.en: Place all the antiquated volumes into a carton and store it elsewhere.
examples.zh: 把所有旧书放进一个箱子里收起来。

basic_explanation: 用 a boy 替代 male child/young lad。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 boy 是基础人称名词。
ogden_principle: boy 是不可替代的基础社会名词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: A young boy was playing with a red ball in the park.
examples.zh: 一个小男孩在公园里玩一个红色的球。

examples.en: A youthful male child was frolicking with a crimson sphere in the recreational area.
examples.zh: 一个小男孩在公园里玩一个红色的球。

basic_explanation: 用 use your brain 替代 think/reason/intellectualize。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 brain 是器官和智力名词。
ogden_principle: brain 体现了名词化。use your brain = think，用 use + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: You need to use your brain to get the answer right.
examples.zh: 你需要动动脑筋才能得到正确答案。

examples.en: You must engage your cognitive faculties to arrive at the correct solution.
examples.zh: 你需要动动脑筋才能得到正确答案。

basic_explanation: 用 put on the brake 替代 brake/decelerate/halt。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 brake 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: brake 体现了名词化。put on the brake = brake，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on the brake when you come to the red light.
examples.zh: 到红灯时踩刹车。

examples.en: Apply the decelerator when you approach the crimson signal.
examples.zh: 到红灯时踩刹车。

basic_explanation: 用 go off on a branch 替代 branch off/diverge。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 branch 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: branch 体现了名词化。go off on a branch = branch off，用核心动词 go + off + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: A small bird was sitting on a high branch of the tree.
examples.zh: 一只小鸟停在树的高枝上。

examples.en: A diminutive avian was perched upon an elevated bough of the arboreal specimen.
examples.zh: 一只小鸟停在树的高枝上。

basic_explanation: 用 made of brick 替代 brick-built/masonry。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 brick 是建筑材料名词。
ogden_principle: brick 体现了名词化。made of brick = brick-built，用 made of + 名词替代形容词。

examples.en: The old house is made of red brick and has a red roof.
examples.zh: 那栋老房子是红砖砌的，屋顶也是红色的。

examples.en: The antiquated dwelling is constructed of fired clay blocks with a crimson roof.
examples.zh: 那栋老房子是红砖砌的，屋顶也是红色的。

basic_explanation: 用 go across a bridge 替代 cross via bridge/span。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bridge 是交通设施名词。
ogden_principle: bridge 体现了名词化。go across a bridge = cross，用核心动词 go + across + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We went across the old stone bridge over the river.
examples.zh: 我们从河上的古石桥上走过。

examples.en: We traversed the ancient masonry viaduct spanning the waterway.
examples.zh: 我们从河上的古石桥上走过。

basic_explanation: 用 give a brush 替代 brush/sweep/clean。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 brush 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: brush 体现了名词化。give a brush = brush/clean，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give your hair a quick brush before we go out.
examples.zh: 我们出门前赶快刷一下头发。

examples.en: Quickly groom your tresses with a bristled implement prior to our departure.
examples.zh: 我们出门前赶快刷一下头发。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a bucket 替代 collect in a bucket。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bucket 是日常容器名词。
ogden_principle: bucket 体现了名词化。put in a bucket = collect，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Fill the bucket with clean water from the well outside.
examples.zh: 从外面的井里打一桶清水。

examples.en: Fill the pail with potable water from the external well.
examples.zh: 从外面的井里打一桶清水。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a new bulb 替代 replace the light source。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bulb 可指灯泡或植物球茎。
ogden_principle: bulb 体现了名词化。put in a new bulb = replace the bulb，用 put + in + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We need to put a new bulb in the light in the hall.
examples.zh: 我们需要给大厅的灯换一个新的灯泡。

examples.en: We must install a new illumination source in the corridor fixture.
examples.zh: 我们需要给大厅的灯换一个新的灯泡。

basic_explanation: 用 put a button on 替代 button/fasten/secure。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 button 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: button 体现了名词化。put a button on = button/fasten，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a new button on your coat where the old one came off.
examples.zh: 在你外套上掉了扣子的地方缝一颗新纽扣。

examples.en: Attach a new fastener to your garment where the previous one detached.
examples.zh: 在你外套上掉了扣子的地方缝一颗新纽扣。

basic_explanation: 用 make a cake 替代 bake/prepare pastry。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cake 是甜点名词。
ogden_principle: cake 体现了名词化。make a cake = bake，用 make + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She made a beautiful cake for her son's birthday party.
examples.zh: 她为儿子的生日派对做了一个漂亮的蛋糕。

examples.en: She baked a gorgeous confection for her offspring's natal celebration.
examples.zh: 她为儿子的生日派对做了一个漂亮的蛋糕。

basic_explanation: 用 take a picture with a camera 替代 photograph/capture。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 camera 是现代设备名词。
ogden_principle: camera 体现了名词化。take a picture with a camera = photograph，用 take + 名词 + with + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Take a picture of us all with your new camera.
examples.zh: 用你的新相机给我们大家拍张照。

examples.en: Capture an image of our entire group with your novel photographic device.
examples.zh: 用你的新相机给我们大家拍张照。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a card 替代 write on a card/record。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 card 可指纸牌或卡片。
ogden_principle: card 体现了名词化。put on a card = record/write，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put your name and number on this card for me.
examples.zh: 把你的名字和号码写在这张卡片上给我。

examples.en: Inscribe your appellation and digits upon this card for my reference.
examples.zh: 把你的名字和号码写在这张卡片上给我。

basic_explanation: 用 go by carriage 替代 travel by horse-drawn vehicle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 carriage 是传统交通工具名词。
ogden_principle: carriage 体现了名词化。go by carriage = travel by coach，用核心动词 go + by + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: In the old days, people went long distances by horse and carriage.
examples.zh: 在过去，人们乘马车出行长途。

examples.en: Historically, individuals traversed extensive distances via equine-drawn conveyances.
examples.zh: 在过去，人们乘马车出行长途。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a cart 替代 load onto a cart/transport。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cart 是传统运输工具名词。
ogden_principle: cart 体现了名词化。put in a cart = load/transport，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the heavy boxes in the cart and take them to market.
examples.zh: 把沉重的箱子装上手推车运到市场去。

examples.en: Load the weighty crates onto the handcart and convey them to the marketplace.
examples.zh: 把沉重的箱子装上手推车运到市场去。

basic_explanation: 用 cat 替代 feline/domestic cat。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cat 是最常见的宠物名词。
ogden_principle: cat 是不可替代的常见动物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping on the warm chair by the window.
examples.zh: 猫在窗边温暖的椅子上睡觉。

examples.en: The feline is slumbering on the heated chair adjacent to the aperture.
examples.zh: 猫在窗边温暖的椅子上睡觉。

basic_explanation: 用 put in chains 替代 chain/shackle/restrain。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 chain 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: chain 体现了名词化。put in chains = chain/restrain，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The dog was put on a chain to keep it in the yard.
examples.zh: 狗被拴上链子关在院子里。

examples.en: The canine was tethered with a metal linkage to confine it within the courtyard.
examples.zh: 狗被拴上链子关在院子里。

basic_explanation: 用 made of cheese 替代 cheesy/cheese-based。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cheese 是基础食物名词。
ogden_principle: cheese 体现了名词化。made of cheese = cheesy，用 made of + 名词替代形容词。

examples.en: Put some cheese on top of the bread and make it hot.
examples.zh: 在面包上放些奶酪然后加热。

examples.en: Apply some dairy product atop the bread and heat it.
examples.zh: 在面包上放些奶酪然后加热。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a chest 替代 store in a chest/trunk。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 chest 可指身体部位或储物箱。
ogden_principle: chest 体现了名词化。put in a chest = store，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He put his old letters away in a wooden chest.
examples.zh: 他把旧信件收进了一个木箱子里。

examples.en: He stored his antiquated correspondence in a timber storage receptacle.
examples.zh: 他把旧信件收进了一个木箱子里。

basic_explanation: 用 put a hand on the chin 替代 rest chin on hand/ponder。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 chin 是面部部位名词。
ogden_principle: chin 是不可替代的身体部位名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: He put his hand on his chin and gave the question deep thought.
examples.zh: 他手托着下巴深入思考这个问题。

examples.en: He rested his manus upon his mandible and contemplated the inquiry profoundly.
examples.zh: 他手托着下巴深入思考这个问题。

basic_explanation: 用 go to church 替代 attend worship/religious service。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 church 是宗教建筑名词。
ogden_principle: church 体现了名词化。go to church = worship，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: They go to church together every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 他们每个星期天早上一起去教堂。

examples.en: They attend religious services together every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 他们每个星期天早上一起去教堂。

basic_explanation: 用 make a circle 替代 form a circle/encircle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 circle 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: circle 体现了名词化。make a circle = encircle，用 make + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The children made a circle and took one another's hands.
examples.zh: 孩子们围成一个圈，手拉着手。

examples.en: The youngsters formed a ring and clasped each other's hands.
examples.zh: 孩子们围成一个圈，手拉着手。

basic_explanation: 用 put the clock right 替代 set the clock/adjust the time。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 clock 是时间测量设备名词。
ogden_principle: clock 体现了名词化。put the clock right = set the clock，用 put + 名词 + right 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put the clock on the wall to the right time, please.
examples.zh: 请把墙上的时钟调准。

examples.en: Adjust the wall-mounted chronometer to the correct temporal indication, please.
examples.zh: 请把墙上的时钟调准。

basic_explanation: 用 go behind a cloud 替代 become cloudy/overcast。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cloud 是气象基础名词。
ogden_principle: cloud 体现了名词化。go behind a cloud = become cloudy，用核心动词 go + behind + 名词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: A dark cloud came over the sun and the day got cold.
examples.zh: 一片乌云遮住了太阳，天变冷了。

examples.en: An ominous nimbus obscured the solar orb and the temperature dropped.
examples.zh: 一片乌云遮住了太阳，天变冷了。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a coat 替代 don a coat/wear outerwear。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 coat 是服装名词。
ogden_principle: coat 体现了名词化。put on a coat = don a coat，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on your warm coat before going out into the cold.
examples.zh: 出去到寒冷中之前穿上暖和的外套。

examples.en: Don your thermal outerwear prior to venturing into the frigid environment.
examples.zh: 出去到寒冷中之前穿上暖和的外套。

basic_explanation: 用 put a collar on 替代 collar/fasten a collar。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 collar 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: collar 体现了名词化。put a collar on = collar，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a clean collar on your shirt before the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会前给你的衬衫换一个干净的领子。

examples.en: Attach a fresh neckband to your shirt prior to the conference.
examples.zh: 开会前给你的衬衫换一个干净的领子。

basic_explanation: 用 give a comb 替代 comb/groom/untangle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 comb 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: comb 体现了名词化。give a comb = comb，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give your hair a good comb before you go out to the party.
examples.zh: 出去参加派对前好好梳一下头发。

examples.en: Thoroughly groom your tresses with a toothed implement prior to the celebration.
examples.zh: 出去参加派对前好好梳一下头发。

basic_explanation: 用 put a cord round 替代 cord/tie/bind。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cord 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: cord 体现了名词化。put a cord round = cord/tie，用 put + 名词 + round 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a cord round the box to keep it shut during transport.
examples.zh: 用绳子把箱子绑好以便运输。

examples.en: Secure the carton with twine to keep it closed during conveyance.
examples.zh: 用绳子把箱子绑好以便运输。

basic_explanation: 用 cow 替代 bovine/dairy animal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cow 是农场动物名词。
ogden_principle: cow 是不可替代的常见家畜名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The cow gives us fresh milk every morning and night.
examples.zh: 母牛每天早上和晚上都给我们提供新鲜牛奶。

examples.en: The bovine provides us with fresh dairy product each morning and evening.
examples.zh: 母牛每天早上和晚上都给我们提供新鲜牛奶。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a cup 替代 pour into a cup/serve。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cup 是日常容器名词。
ogden_principle: cup 体现了名词化。put in a cup = pour/serve，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the hot tea in a clean cup and let it cool a little.
examples.zh: 把热茶倒进一个干净的杯子里，让它凉一会儿。

examples.en: Pour the heated infusion into a sanitized vessel and allow it to cool slightly.
examples.zh: 把热茶倒进一个干净的杯子里，让它凉一会儿。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a curtain 替代 hang a curtain/drape。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 curtain 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: curtain 体现了名词化。put up a curtain = drape，用 put + up + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put up a new curtain in the bedroom to keep out the morning sun.
examples.zh: 在卧室挂上新窗帘来遮挡早晨的阳光。

examples.en: Install a new window drapery in the sleeping chamber to block the morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 在卧室挂上新窗帘来遮挡早晨的阳光。

basic_explanation: 用 put a cushion on 替代 cushion/pad/soften。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cushion 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: cushion 体现了名词化。put a cushion on = cushion/pad，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a soft cushion on the hard chair to make it comfortable.
examples.zh: 在硬椅子上放一个软垫让它舒服些。

examples.en: Place a padded support on the rigid chair to enhance comfort.
examples.zh: 在硬椅子上放一个软垫让它舒服些。

basic_explanation: 用 dog 替代 canine/domestic dog。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dog 是最常见的宠物名词。
ogden_principle: dog 是不可替代的常见动物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The dog was running after a stick in the garden.
examples.zh: 狗在花园里追着一根棍子跑。

examples.en: The canine was pursuing a branch in the garden.
examples.zh: 狗在花园里追着一根棍子跑。

basic_explanation: 用 put the door to 替代 close/shut the door。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 door 是建筑基础名词。
ogden_principle: door 体现了名词化。put the door to = close，用 put + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Please put the door to when you come in from outside.
examples.zh: 从外面进来时请把门关上。

examples.en: Please close the entrance when you enter from the exterior.
examples.zh: 从外面进来时请把门关上。

basic_explanation: 用 go down the drain 替代 drain away/disappear/waste。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 drain 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: drain 体现了名词化。go down the drain = drain away，用核心动词 go + down + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The water went slowly down the drain in the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 水慢慢地从厨房地漏流走了。

examples.en: The liquid gradually descended through the drainage aperture in the culinary surface.
examples.zh: 水慢慢地从厨房地漏流走了。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a drawer 替代 store in a drawer/file away。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 drawer 是家具部件名词。
ogden_principle: drawer 体现了名词化。put in a drawer = store，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the clean clothes away in the top drawer of the chest.
examples.zh: 把干净衣服收进柜子最上面的抽屉里。

examples.en: Store the laundered garments in the uppermost compartment of the dresser.
examples.zh: 把干净衣服收进柜子最上面的抽屉里。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a dress 替代 dress/don a garment。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dress 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: dress 体现了名词化。put on a dress = dress，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She put on a beautiful blue dress for the evening party.
examples.zh: 她穿上了一条漂亮的蓝裙子去参加晚会。

examples.en: She donned a stunning azure gown for the evening celebration.
examples.zh: 她穿上了一条漂亮的蓝裙子去参加晚会。

basic_explanation: 用 let a drop fall 替代 drop/drip/trickle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 drop 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: drop 体现了名词化。let a drop fall = drop，用 let + 名词 + fall 替代动词。

examples.en: A drop of rain fell on her hand from the dark sky.
examples.zh: 一滴雨从阴暗的天空落到她手上。

examples.en: A droplet of precipitation descended upon her manus from the overcast firmament.
examples.zh: 一滴雨从阴暗的天空落到她手上。

basic_explanation: 用 give ear to 替代 listen/hear/pay attention。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ear 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: ear 体现了名词化。give ear to = listen，用 give + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Please give ear to what I am about to say to you all.
examples.zh: 请听好我要对大家说的话。

examples.en: Please lend your auditory attention to what I am about to articulate.
examples.zh: 请听好我要对大家说的话。

basic_explanation: 用 put an egg in 替代 add an egg/cook with egg。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 egg 是基础食物名词。
ogden_principle: egg 体现了名词化。put an egg in = add an egg，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put an egg in the hot water and cook it for five minutes.
examples.zh: 把一个鸡蛋放进热水里煮五分钟。

examples.en: Place an ovum into the boiling liquid and cook it for five minutes.
examples.zh: 把一个鸡蛋放进热水里煮五分钟。

basic_explanation: 用 put the engine on 替代 start the engine/ignite。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 engine 是机械动力名词。
ogden_principle: engine 体现了名词化。put the engine on = start the engine，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put the engine on and let the car get warm before we go.
examples.zh: 发动引擎，让车热一下我们再走。

examples.en: Start the motor and allow the vehicle to warm up prior to departure.
examples.zh: 发动引擎，让车热一下我们再走。

basic_explanation: 用 keep an eye on 替代 watch/monitor/observe。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 eye 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: eye 体现了名词化。keep an eye on = watch，用 keep + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Please keep an eye on the baby while I go to the store.
examples.zh: 我去商店时请照看一下宝宝。

examples.en: Please supervise the infant while I visit the retail establishment.
examples.zh: 我去商店时请照看一下宝宝。

basic_explanation: 用 put a face on 替代 make a face/express/show emotion。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 face 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: face 体现了名词化。put a face on = express/show emotion，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词短语。

examples.en: She put on a happy face even though she was feeling sad.
examples.zh: 虽然她心里难过，脸上还是挂着笑容。

examples.en: She displayed a cheerful countenance despite experiencing sadness internally.
examples.zh: 虽然她心里难过，脸上还是挂着笑容。

basic_explanation: 用 work on a farm 替代 farm/cultivate/raise crops。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 farm 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: farm 体现了名词化。work on a farm = farm，用 work + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He works on a farm growing food plants and keeping animals.
examples.zh: 他在一个农场上种植粮食和饲养动物。

examples.en: He labors on an agricultural establishment cultivating crops and raising livestock.
examples.zh: 他在一个农场上种植粮食和饲养动物。

basic_explanation: 用 put a feather in 替代 decorate with a feather/adorn。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 feather 是鸟类特征名词。
ogden_principle: feather 体现了名词化。put a feather in = adorn with a feather，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词短语。

examples.en: The bird has beautiful blue feathers on its long tail.
examples.zh: 那只鸟的长尾巴上有美丽的蓝色羽毛。

examples.en: The avian possesses stunning azure plumage on its elongated caudal appendage.
examples.zh: 那只鸟的长尾巴上有美丽的蓝色羽毛。

basic_explanation: 用 put a finger on 替代 touch/identify/pinpoint。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 finger 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: finger 体现了名词化。put a finger on = touch/identify，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词短语。

examples.en: She put her finger on the map to show us the way.
examples.zh: 她用手指在地图上给我们指路。

examples.en: She placed her digit upon the cartographic representation to indicate the route.
examples.zh: 她用手指在地图上给我们指路。

basic_explanation: 用 go for fish 替代 fish/go fishing。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 fish 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: fish 体现了名词化。go for fish = go fishing，用核心动词 go + for + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We went to the river to get fish for our evening meal.
examples.zh: 我们去河里捕鱼做晚餐。

examples.en: We proceeded to the waterway to procure aquatic protein for our evening repast.
examples.zh: 我们去河里捕鱼做晚餐。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a flag 替代 raise a flag/hoist。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 flag 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: flag 体现了名词化。put up a flag = raise/hoist a flag，用 put + up + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: They put up the flag on the tall pole for the holiday.
examples.zh: 他们为节日在高杆上升起了旗帜。

examples.en: They hoisted the banner on the elevated mast for the celebration.
examples.zh: 他们为节日在高杆上升起了旗帜。

basic_explanation: 用 put on the floor 替代 place on the floor/lay down。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 floor 是建筑基础名词。
ogden_principle: floor 体现了名词化。put on the floor = lay down，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the heavy box down on the floor by the door.
examples.zh: 把重箱子放在门边的地板上。

examples.en: Place the weighty carton upon the ground surface adjacent to the entrance.
examples.zh: 把重箱子放在门边的地板上。

basic_explanation: 用 go for a fly 替代 fly/take flight/soar。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 fly 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: fly 体现了名词化。go for a fly = fly，用核心动词 go + for + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The bird went up into the air for a long fly across the lake.
examples.zh: 那只鸟飞上天空，飞越了湖面。

examples.en: The avian ascended for an extended flight across the lacustrine expanse.
examples.zh: 那只鸟飞上天空，飞越了湖面。

basic_explanation: 用 go on foot 替代 walk/travel by walking。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 foot 可指身体部位或度量单位。
ogden_principle: foot 体现了名词化。go on foot = walk，用核心动词 go + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We went all the way to the town on foot, not by car.
examples.zh: 我们一路步行到镇上，没有开车。

examples.en: We traversed the entire distance to the municipality by ambulation rather than automobile.
examples.zh: 我们一路步行到镇上，没有开车。

basic_explanation: 用 put a fork in 替代 pierce with a fork/skewer。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 fork 是餐具名词。
ogden_principle: fork 体现了名词化。put a fork in = pierce，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put your fork in the meat to see if it is ready to eat.
examples.zh: 用叉子戳一下肉看看熟了没有。

examples.en: Pierce the flesh with your pronged utensil to ascertain its readiness for consumption.
examples.zh: 用叉子戳一下肉看看熟了没有。

basic_explanation: 用 fowl 替代 domestic bird/poultry。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 fowl 是禽类统称。
ogden_principle: fowl 入选因为它覆盖了所有可食用的家养鸟类。Basic English 用它替代 chicken、duck、turkey 等具体禽类名。

examples.en: They keep fowl on the farm for fresh eggs and meat.
examples.zh: 他们在农场上养家禽来获取新鲜蛋和肉。

examples.en: They raise domestic birds on the agricultural establishment for fresh eggs and protein.
examples.zh: 他们在农场上养家禽来获取新鲜蛋和肉。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a frame 替代 frame/mount/encase。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 frame 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: frame 体现了名词化。put in a frame = frame/mount，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the old picture in a new wooden frame on the wall.
examples.zh: 把旧画放进新的木框里挂到墙上。

examples.en: Mount the antiquated illustration in a novel timber enclosure upon the partition.
examples.zh: 把旧画放进新的木框里挂到墙上。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a garden 替代 garden/plant/cultivate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 garden 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: garden 体现了名词化。put in a garden = garden/plant，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We put new flowers in the garden every spring when the weather gets warm.
examples.zh: 每年春天天气变暖时我们都在花园里种新花。

examples.en: We plant new flora in the horticultural space each spring when temperatures rise.
examples.zh: 每年春天天气变暖时我们都在花园里种新花。

basic_explanation: 用 a girl 替代 female child/young female。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 girl 是基础人称名词。
ogden_principle: girl 是不可替代的基础社会名词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: A young girl was reading a book under the tall tree.
examples.zh: 一个小女孩在大树下读书。

examples.en: A youthful female child was perusing a volume beneath the towering arboreal specimen.
examples.zh: 一个小女孩在大树下读书。

basic_explanation: 用 put on gloves 替代 wear gloves/don handwear。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 glove 是服饰名词。
ogden_principle: glove 体现了名词化。put on gloves = don gloves，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on your warm gloves before going out into the snow.
examples.zh: 出去到雪地里之前戴上你的保暖手套。

examples.en: Don your thermal hand coverings prior to venturing into the snow.
examples.zh: 出去到雪地里之前戴上你的保暖手套。

basic_explanation: 用 goat 替代 caprine animal/mountain grazer。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 goat 是家畜名词。
ogden_principle: goat 入选因为它是全球最常见的家畜之一。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The goat was up on the high rocks looking for food.
examples.zh: 山羊在高高的岩石上寻找食物。

examples.en: The caprine creature was upon the elevated boulders foraging for sustenance.
examples.zh: 山羊在高高的岩石上寻找食物。

basic_explanation: 用 go off like a gun 替代 fire/discharge/explode。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 gun 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: gun 体现了名词化。go off like a gun = fire/explode，用核心动词 go + off + like + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The sound of the starting gun sent the runners on their way.
examples.zh: 发令枪的声音一响，赛跑者就出发了。

examples.en: The report of the starting firearm dispatched the athletes on their course.
examples.zh: 发令枪的声音一响，赛跑者就出发了。

basic_explanation: 用 put up hair 替代 style hair/arrange tresses。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 hair 是身体特征名词。
ogden_principle: hair 体现了名词化。put up hair = style/arrange hair，用 put + up + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: She put her long hair up with a bright red band.
examples.zh: 她用一条鲜红的发带把长发束了起来。

examples.en: She secured her lengthy tresses with a vibrant crimson circlet.
examples.zh: 她用一条鲜红的发带把长发束了起来。

basic_explanation: 用 give a hammer to 替代 hammer/pound/flatten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 hammer 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: hammer 体现了名词化。give a hammer to = hammer，用 give + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Give the nail a good hit with the hammer to get it in.
examples.zh: 用锤子好好敲一下钉子把它钉进去。

examples.en: Strike the nail forcefully with the mallet to embed it.
examples.zh: 用锤子好好敲一下钉子把它钉进去。

basic_explanation: 用 give a hand to 替代 help/assist/aid。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 hand 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: hand 体现了名词化。give a hand to = help/assist，用 give + 名词 + to 替代动词。这是 Basic English 最经典的表达之一。

examples.en: Please give me a hand with these heavy boxes of books.
examples.zh: 请帮我搬一下这几箱沉重的书。

examples.en: Please assist me with these weighty cartons of volumes.
examples.zh: 请帮我搬一下这几箱沉重的书。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a hat 替代 don a hat/cover head。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 hat 是服饰名词。
ogden_principle: hat 体现了名词化。put on a hat = don a hat，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on your hat to keep the strong sun off your face.
examples.zh: 戴上帽子挡住强烈的阳光。

examples.en: Don your head covering to shield your visage from the intense solar radiation.
examples.zh: 戴上帽子挡住强烈的阳光。

basic_explanation: 用 put out of your head 替代 forget/dismiss/ignore。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 head 是身体部位和思维名词。
ogden_principle: head 体现了名词化。put out of your head = forget，用 put + out of + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the bad memory out of your head and move on.
examples.zh: 把那段糟糕的记忆从你脑海中抹去，继续前行。

examples.en: Expunge the unpleasant recollection from your consciousness and proceed forward.
examples.zh: 把那段糟糕的记忆从你脑海中抹去，继续前行。

basic_explanation: 用 put your heart into 替代 dedicate/commit/apply yourself。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 heart 是器官和情感名词。
ogden_principle: heart 体现了名词化。put your heart into = dedicate yourself，用 put + 名词 + into 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put your heart into the work and it will come out well.
examples.zh: 用心投入工作，结果就会好。

examples.en: Apply yourself wholeheartedly to the task and the outcome shall be favorable.
examples.zh: 用心投入工作，结果就会好。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a hook 替代 hook/hang/suspend。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 hook 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: hook 体现了名词化。put on a hook = hook/hang，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put your wet coat on the hook by the fire to dry.
examples.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在火边的钩子上晾干。

examples.en: Hang your damp garment on the peg near the hearth to desiccate.
examples.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在火边的钩子上晾干。

basic_explanation: 用 give a sound on the horn 替代 blow the horn/sound/honk。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 horn 可指动物角或乐器。
ogden_principle: horn 体现了名词化。give a sound on the horn = blow/honk，用 give + 名词 + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The driver gave a loud sound on the horn to warn the walkers.
examples.zh: 司机大声按喇叭警告行人。

examples.en: The motorist emitted a resonant blast on the acoustic warning device to alert the pedestrians.
examples.zh: 司机大声按喇叭警告行人。

basic_explanation: 用 go on a horse 替代 ride/horseback ride。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 horse 是常见动物名词。
ogden_principle: horse 体现了名词化。go on a horse = ride，用核心动词 go + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We went through the fields on a horse in the early morning.
examples.zh: 我们清晨骑着马穿过田野。

examples.en: We traversed the meadows on horseback in the early morning.
examples.zh: 我们清晨骑着马穿过田野。

basic_explanation: 用 go to hospital 替代 be hospitalized/seek medical care。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 hospital 是医疗设施名词。
ogden_principle: hospital 体现了名词化。go to hospital = be hospitalized，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代被动结构。

examples.en: He had to go to hospital after the bad fall from the tree.
examples.zh: 他从树上摔下来后不得不去了医院。

examples.en: He was obliged to seek medical attention at the infirmary after the severe arboreal descent.
examples.zh: 他从树上摔下来后不得不去了医院。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a house 替代 build/construct a house。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 house 是建筑基础名词。
ogden_principle: house 体现了名词化。put up a house = build a house，用 put + up + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: They put up a new house on the land by the river.
examples.zh: 他们在河边的土地上建了一座新房子。

examples.en: They constructed a new residence on the property adjacent to the waterway.
examples.zh: 他们在河边的土地上建了一座新房子。

basic_explanation: 用 go to an island 替代 visit an island/isle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 island 是地理基础名词。
ogden_principle: island 是不可替代的地理概念名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: We took a boat to a small island in the middle of the sea.
examples.zh: 我们乘船去了海中一座小岛。

examples.en: We voyaged by watercraft to a diminutive isle in the midst of the ocean.
examples.zh: 我们乘船去了海中一座小岛。

basic_explanation: 用 put on jewels 替代 wear jewelry/adorn with gems。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 jewel 是贵重物品名词。
ogden_principle: jewel 体现了名词化。put on jewels = wear jewelry，用 put + on + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: She put on her best jewels for the great evening party.
examples.zh: 她戴上了最好的珠宝去参加盛大的晚会。

examples.en: She donned her finest gemstones for the grand evening celebration.
examples.zh: 她戴上了最好的珠宝去参加盛大的晚会。

basic_explanation: 用 put the kettle on 替代 boil water/heat the kettle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 kettle 是厨房用品名词。
ogden_principle: kettle 体现了名词化。put the kettle on = boil water，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词短语。这是英式英语的经典表达。

examples.en: Put the kettle on and we will have some hot tea together.
examples.zh: 烧壶水，我们一起喝杯热茶。

examples.en: Activate the water heating vessel and we shall enjoy some warm tea together.
examples.zh: 烧壶水，我们一起喝杯热茶。

basic_explanation: 用 put the key in 替代 unlock/insert key/open。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 key 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: key 体现了名词化。put the key in = unlock，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put the key in the lock and give it a turn to open the door.
examples.zh: 把钥匙插进锁里转一下打开门。

examples.en: Insert the unlocking device into the mechanism and rotate it to open the entrance.
examples.zh: 把钥匙插进锁里转一下打开门。

basic_explanation: 用 go down on one knee 替代 kneel/genuflect。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 knee 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: knee 体现了名词化。go down on one knee = kneel，用核心动词 go + down + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He went down on one knee and asked her to be his wife.
examples.zh: 他单膝跪下向她求婚。

examples.en: He genuflected on a single joint and petitioned for her hand in matrimony.
examples.zh: 他单膝跪下向她求婚。

basic_explanation: 用 put a knife to 替代 cut/slice with a knife。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 knife 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: knife 体现了名词化。put a knife to = cut/slice，用 put + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a sharp knife to the bread and cut it thin.
examples.zh: 用锋利的刀把面包切成薄片。

examples.en: Apply a honed blade to the loaf and slice it thinly.
examples.zh: 用锋利的刀把面包切成薄片。

basic_explanation: 用 put a knot in 替代 knot/tie/fasten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 knot 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: knot 体现了名词化。put a knot in = knot/tie，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a strong knot in the cord to keep the box shut.
examples.zh: 在绳子上打一个结实的结把箱子绑紧。

examples.en: Secure a firm knot in the twine to keep the carton fastened.
examples.zh: 在绳子上打一个结实的结把箱子绑紧。

basic_explanation: 用 put out leaves 替代 grow leaves/foliage。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 leaf 是植物学基础名词。
ogden_principle: leaf 体现了名词化。put out leaves = grow foliage，用 put + out + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The trees put out new green leaves every spring after the cold.
examples.zh: 每年春天寒冷过后树都会长出新的绿叶。

examples.en: The arboreal specimens produce fresh verdant foliage each spring following the frigid season.
examples.zh: 每年春天寒冷过后树都会长出新的绿叶。

basic_explanation: 用 give a leg up 替代 help/assist/boost。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 leg 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: leg 体现了名词化。give a leg up = help/boost，用 give + 名词 + up 替代动词短语。

examples.en: He gave the boy a leg up over the high wall.
examples.zh: 他帮男孩一把翻过了高墙。

examples.en: He provided the youth with a boost over the elevated barrier.
examples.zh: 他帮男孩一把翻过了高墙。

basic_explanation: 用 go to the library 替代 visit the library/borrow books。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 library 是文化设施名词。
ogden_principle: library 体现了名词化。go to the library = borrow books，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: I go to the library every week to get new books to read.
examples.zh: 我每周都去图书馆借新书来读。

examples.en: I visit the bibliotheca weekly to procure new volumes for perusal.
examples.zh: 我每周都去图书馆借新书来读。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a line 替代 line up/align/queue。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 line 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: line 体现了名词化。put in a line = line up/align，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the chairs in a straight line along the back wall.
examples.zh: 把椅子沿后墙排成一条直线。

examples.en: Arrange the seating in a linear configuration along the rear partition.
examples.zh: 把椅子沿后墙排成一条直线。

basic_explanation: 用 put a finger to the lip 替代 shush/quiet/signal silence。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 lip 是面部部位名词。
ogden_principle: lip 体现了名词化。put a finger to the lip = shush，用 put + 名词 + to + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She put a finger to her lip to tell us to be quiet.
examples.zh: 她把手指放到嘴唇上示意我们安静。

examples.en: She placed a digit upon her labium to signal for silence.
examples.zh: 她把手指放到嘴唇上示意我们安静。

basic_explanation: 用 put a lock on 替代 lock/secures/fasten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 lock 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: lock 体现了名词化。put a lock on = lock/secure，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a strong lock on the door when you go out at night.
examples.zh: 晚上出门时给门上一把结实的锁。

examples.en: Secure the entrance with a robust locking mechanism when you depart nocturnally.
examples.zh: 晚上出门时给门上一把结实的锁。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a map 替代 map/chart/plot。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 map 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: map 体现了名词化。put on a map = map/chart，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the way to the old house on a map for me, please.
examples.zh: 请在地图上给我标出去那座老房子的路。

examples.en: Chart the route to the antiquated dwelling on a cartographic representation for me, please.
examples.zh: 请在地图上给我标出去那座老房子的路。

basic_explanation: 用 put a match to 替代 light/ignite/strike a match。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 match 可指火柴或比赛。
ogden_principle: match 体现了名词化。put a match to = light/ignite，用 put + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a match to the dry wood and soon we will have a fire.
examples.zh: 用火柴点燃干木头，我们很快就有火了。

examples.en: Apply an ignition stick to the desiccated timber and we shall soon have a conflagration.
examples.zh: 用火柴点燃干木头，我们很快就有火了。

basic_explanation: 用 go like a monkey 替代 act like a monkey/clown around。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 monkey 是常见动物名词。
ogden_principle: monkey 是不可替代的常见灵长类动物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The children went up the tree like little monkeys.
examples.zh: 孩子们像小猴子一样爬上了树。

examples.en: The youngsters ascended the arboreal specimen like diminutive primates.
examples.zh: 孩子们像小猴子一样爬上了树。

basic_explanation: 用 come out like the moon 替代 appear/emerge/shine。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 moon 是天文基础名词。
ogden_principle: moon 是不可替代的自然天体名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The full moon came up over the dark trees at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚满月从黑暗的树梢上升起。

examples.en: The complete lunar orb ascended above the shadowy arboreal specimens nocturnally.
examples.zh: 夜晚满月从黑暗的树梢上升起。

basic_explanation: 用 put words in the mouth of 替代 speak for/put words into someone's mouth。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 mouth 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: mouth 体现了名词化。put words in the mouth of = speak for，用 put + 名词 + in + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Do not put words in my mouth that I did not say.
examples.zh: 不要把不是我说的话强加给我。

examples.en: Do not attribute statements to me that I did not utter.
examples.zh: 不要把不是我说的话强加给我。

basic_explanation: 用 put muscle into 替代 exert/strengthen/power through。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 muscle 是身体组织名词。
ogden_principle: muscle 体现了名词化。put muscle into = exert/strengthen，用 put + 名词 + into 替代动词。

examples.en: You need to put some muscle into it to get the door open.
examples.zh: 你得用点力气才能把门打开。

examples.en: You must apply some physical force to pry the entrance ajar.
examples.zh: 你得用点力气才能把门打开。

basic_explanation: 用 put a nail in 替代 nail/hammer/fasten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 nail 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: nail 体现了名词化。put a nail in = nail/fasten，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a strong nail in the wall to hang the picture on.
examples.zh: 在墙上钉一颗结实的钉子来挂画。

examples.en: Drive a sturdy metal fastener into the partition to suspend the illustration.
examples.zh: 在墙上钉一颗结实的钉子来挂画。

basic_explanation: 用 put round the neck 替代 hang around the neck/wear as necklace。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 neck 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: neck 体现了名词化。put round the neck = wear around the neck，用 put + round + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: She put a warm red cloth round her neck against the cold wind.
examples.zh: 她把一条暖和的红色围巾围在脖子上抵御寒风。

examples.en: She wrapped a thermal crimson textile around her cervical region against the frigid gusts.
examples.zh: 她把一条暖和的红色围巾围在脖子上抵御寒风。

basic_explanation: 用 put a needle through 替代 sew/stitch/pierce。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 needle 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: needle 体现了名词化。put a needle through = sew/stitch，用 put + 名词 + through 替代动词。

examples.en: She put the needle through the cloth to make a new dress.
examples.zh: 她用针穿过布料做一条新裙子。

examples.en: She passed the sewing implement through the fabric to create a new garment.
examples.zh: 她用针穿过布料做一条新裙子。

basic_explanation: 用 have the nerve to 替代 dare/be brave enough。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 nerve 是生理学和心理学名词。
ogden_principle: nerve 体现了名词化。have the nerve to = dare，用 have + 名词 + to 替代情态动词。

examples.en: He had the nerve to put his hand up and ask a hard question.
examples.zh: 他鼓起勇气举手提了一个很难的问题。

examples.en: He possessed the audacity to raise his manus and pose a challenging inquiry.
examples.zh: 他鼓起勇气举手提了一个很难的问题。

basic_explanation: 用 put out a net 替代 cast a net/trawl/ensnare。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 net 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: net 体现了名词化。put out a net = cast/trawl，用 put + out + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The fisherman put out his net to get fish from the sea.
examples.zh: 渔夫撒下网从海里捕鱼。

examples.en: The angler deployed his mesh apparatus to harvest aquatic creatures from the ocean.
examples.zh: 渔夫撒下网从海里捕鱼。

basic_explanation: 用 put the nose into 替代 pry/snoop/meddle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 nose 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: nose 体现了名词化。put the nose into = pry/meddle，用 put + 名词 + into 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Do not put your nose into other people's private things.
examples.zh: 不要打探别人的私事。

examples.en: Do not pry into the personal affairs of others.
examples.zh: 不要打探别人的私事。

basic_explanation: 用 put a nut on 替代 fasten with a nut/secure。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 nut 可指食物或机械零件。
ogden_principle: nut 体现了名词化。put a nut on = fasten/secure，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a nut on the end of the bolt to keep it tight.
examples.zh: 在螺栓末端拧上螺帽把它拧紧。

examples.en: Secure a threaded fastener onto the extremity of the bolt to maintain tension.
examples.zh: 在螺栓末端拧上螺帽把它拧紧。

basic_explanation: 用 go to the office 替代 work in an office/attend workplace。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 office 是工作场所名词。
