ogden_principle: office 体现了名词化。go to the office = work，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He goes to the office early every morning before the sun is up.
examples.zh: 他每天天还没亮就早早去办公室了。

examples.en: He commutes to the workplace early each morning prior to sunrise.
examples.zh: 他每天天还没亮就早早去办公室了。

basic_explanation: 用 give an orange 替代 offer an orange/citrus fruit。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 orange 是水果和颜色名词。
ogden_principle: orange 体现了名词化。give an orange = offer a citrus fruit，用 give + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: She gave me a sweet orange from the tree in her garden.
examples.zh: 她从花园的树上摘了一个甜橙子给我。

examples.en: She offered me a sweet citrus fruit from the arboreal specimen in her horticultural space.
examples.zh: 她从花园的树上摘了一个甜橙子给我。

basic_explanation: 用 put in the oven 替代 bake/roast/cook in oven。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 oven 是厨房设备名词。
ogden_principle: oven 体现了名词化。put in the oven = bake/roast，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the bread in the hot oven and let it cook for an hour.
examples.zh: 把面包放进热烤箱里烤一个小时。

examples.en: Place the dough in the heated baking chamber and allow it to cook for sixty minutes.
examples.zh: 把面包放进热烤箱里烤一个小时。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a parcel 替代 parcel/wrap/pack。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 parcel 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: parcel 体现了名词化。put in a parcel = parcel/wrap，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the books in a parcel and send them by post to him.
examples.zh: 把书打成包裹邮寄给他。

examples.en: Wrap the volumes in a package and dispatch them via postal service to him.
examples.zh: 把书打成包裹邮寄给他。

basic_explanation: 用 put pen to paper 替代 write/compose/draft。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pen 是书写工具名词。
ogden_principle: pen 体现了名词化。put pen to paper = write，用 put + 名词 + to + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He put pen to paper and wrote a long letter to his friend.
examples.zh: 他提笔给朋友写了一封长信。

examples.en: He applied his writing instrument to the surface and composed an extensive correspondence to his companion.
examples.zh: 他提笔给朋友写了一封长信。

basic_explanation: 用 put down in pencil 替代 write in pencil/draft/sketch。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pencil 是书写工具名词。
ogden_principle: pencil 体现了名词化。put down in pencil = write/draft，用 put + down + in + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put your name down in pencil so you can change it later if needed.
examples.zh: 用铅笔写下你的名字，这样需要的话以后可以改。

examples.en: Inscribe your appellation with a graphite implement so it can be modified subsequently if necessary.
examples.zh: 用铅笔写下你的名字，这样需要的话以后可以改。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a picture 替代 hang a picture/display art。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 picture 是视觉艺术名词。
ogden_principle: picture 体现了名词化。put up a picture = hang/display，用 put + up + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put up a bright picture on the wall to make the room look happy.
examples.zh: 在墙上挂一幅明亮的画让房间看起来更愉快。

examples.en: Hang a vibrant illustration upon the partition to make the chamber appear cheerful.
examples.zh: 在墙上挂一幅明亮的画让房间看起来更愉快。

basic_explanation: 用 keep a pig 替代 raise a pig/farm swine。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pig 是家畜名词。
ogden_principle: pig 是不可替代的常见农场动物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: They keep a pig on the farm to give them fresh meat.
examples.zh: 他们在农场上养了一头猪来提供新鲜肉。

examples.en: They raise a porcine specimen on the agricultural establishment to provide fresh protein.
examples.zh: 他们在农场上养了一头猪来提供新鲜肉。

basic_explanation: 用 put a pin through 替代 pin/fasten/secure。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pin 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: pin 体现了名词化。put a pin through = pin/fasten，用 put + 名词 + through 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a pin through the papers to keep them all together.
examples.zh: 用别针把文件别在一起。

examples.en: Fasten the documents together with a metal pin to keep them organized.
examples.zh: 用别针把文件别在一起。

basic_explanation: 用 go through a pipe 替代 flow through a pipe/conduit。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pipe 可指水管或烟斗。
ogden_principle: pipe 体现了名词化。go through a pipe = flow，用核心动词 go + through + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The water goes through a long pipe under the street to the house.
examples.zh: 水通过街道下面长长的管道流进屋里。

examples.en: The liquid travels through an extended conduit beneath the thoroughfare to the residence.
examples.zh: 水通过街道下面长长的管道流进屋里。

basic_explanation: 用 go by plane 替代 fly/travel by air。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 plane 是现代交通工具名词。
ogden_principle: plane 体现了名词化。go by plane = fly，用核心动词 go + by + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We went by plane across the sea to a far country.
examples.zh: 我们乘飞机飞越大海去了一个遥远的国家。

examples.en: We traveled via aircraft across the ocean to a distant nation.
examples.zh: 我们乘飞机飞越大海去了一个遥远的国家。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a plate 替代 serve/plate/dish up。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 plate 是餐具名词。
ogden_principle: plate 体现了名词化。put on a plate = serve，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the hot food on a clean plate and bring it to the table.
examples.zh: 把热食物盛到干净的盘子里端上桌。

examples.en: Serve the heated cuisine on a sanitized dish and convey it to the dining surface.
examples.zh: 把热食物盛到干净的盘子里端上桌。

basic_explanation: 用 put a plough through 替代 plough/till/cultivate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 plough 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: plough 体现了名词化。put a plough through = plough/till，用 put + 名词 + through 替代动词。

examples.en: The farmer put the plough through the field before planting.
examples.zh: 农民在播种前用犁翻了地。

examples.en: The agriculturalist drew the tillage implement through the field prior to sowing.
examples.zh: 农民在播种前用犁翻了地。

basic_explanation: 用 put in your pocket 替代 pocket/store/carry。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pocket 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: pocket 体现了名词化。put in your pocket = pocket/store，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the key in your pocket so you do not lose it on the way.
examples.zh: 把钥匙放进口袋里免得路上丢了。

examples.en: Place the key into your garment pouch so you do not misplace it during transit.
examples.zh: 把钥匙放进口袋里免得路上丢了。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a pot 替代 cook in a pot/stew/boil。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pot 是烹饪容器名词。
ogden_principle: pot 体现了名词化。put in a pot = stew/boil，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the meat and vegetables in a large pot to make soup.
examples.zh: 把肉和蔬菜放进大锅里煮汤。

examples.en: Place the protein and vegetation into a sizable cauldron to prepare broth.
examples.zh: 把肉和蔬菜放进大锅里煮汤。

basic_explanation: 用 put potatoes in 替代 add potatoes/cook with potatoes。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 potato 是基础食物名词。
ogden_principle: potato 体现了名词化。put potatoes in = add potatoes，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put some potatoes in the hot water and cook them until soft.
examples.zh: 把一些土豆放进热水里煮到软。

examples.en: Place some tubers into the boiling liquid and cook them until tender.
examples.zh: 把一些土豆放进热水里煮到软。

basic_explanation: 用 put in prison 替代 imprison/jail/incarcerate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 prison 是司法设施名词。
ogden_principle: prison 体现了名词化。put in prison = imprison，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The judge put the man in prison for his crime against others.
examples.zh: 法官把那个犯罪的人关进了监狱。

examples.en: The magistrate incarcerated the individual for his offenses against fellow citizens.
examples.zh: 法官把那个犯罪的人关进了监狱。

basic_explanation: 用 put the pump on 替代 pump/activate the pump。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 pump 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: pump 体现了名词化。put the pump on = pump/activate，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put the water pump on to get fresh water from the well.
examples.zh: 打开水泵从井里抽新鲜水上来。

examples.en: Activate the water extraction mechanism to obtain fresh liquid from the well.
examples.zh: 打开水泵从井里抽新鲜水上来。

basic_explanation: 用 go by rail 替代 travel by train/railway。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 rail 是交通基础设施名词。
ogden_principle: rail 体现了名词化。go by rail = travel by train，用核心动词 go + by + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We went by rail from one side of the country to the other.
examples.zh: 我们乘火车从国家的一边到了另一边。

examples.en: We traveled via railway from one extremity of the nation to the opposite.
examples.zh: 我们乘火车从国家的一边到了另一边。

basic_explanation: 用 go after a rat 替代 chase a rat/hunt rodents。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 rat 是常见啮齿动物名词。
ogden_principle: rat 是不可替代的常见小动物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The cat went after a rat in the dark corner of the room.
examples.zh: 猫在房间的黑暗角落里追一只老鼠。

examples.en: The feline pursued a rodent in the shadowy corner of the chamber.
examples.zh: 猫在房间的黑暗角落里追一只老鼠。

basic_explanation: 用 give a receipt for 替代 provide a receipt/acknowledge payment。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 receipt 是商业名词。
ogden_principle: receipt 体现了名词化。give a receipt for = acknowledge payment，用 give + 名词 + for 替代动词短语。

examples.en: The store gave me a receipt for the things I got there.
examples.zh: 商店给了我所购物品的收据。

examples.en: The establishment provided me with a proof of purchase for the items I acquired.
examples.zh: 商店给了我所购物品的收据。

basic_explanation: 用 put a ring on 替代 ring/encircle/wear a ring。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ring 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: ring 体现了名词化。put a ring on = wear a ring/encircle，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词短语。

examples.en: He put a beautiful gold ring on her finger at the wedding.
examples.zh: 在婚礼上他把一枚漂亮的金戒指戴在她手指上。

examples.en: He placed a stunning golden circlet upon her digit during the nuptial ceremony.
examples.zh: 在婚礼上他把一枚漂亮的金戒指戴在她手指上。

basic_explanation: 用 put a rod through 替代 thread a rod/pierce with a rod。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 rod 是长条形物体名词。
ogden_principle: rod 体现了名词化。put a rod through = thread/pierce，用 put + 名词 + through 替代动词。

examples.en: Put the metal rod through the holes to keep the door shut.
examples.zh: 把金属杆穿过洞孔把门闩住。

examples.en: Insert the metallic bar through the apertures to secure the entrance closed.
examples.zh: 把金属杆穿过洞孔把门闩住。

basic_explanation: 用 put a roof on 替代 roof/cover/shelter。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 roof 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: roof 体现了名词化。put a roof on = roof/cover，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: They put a new red roof on the old house last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天他们给老房子盖了新红屋顶。

examples.en: They installed a new crimson covering atop the antiquated dwelling last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天他们给老房子盖了新红屋顶。

basic_explanation: 用 put down roots 替代 establish roots/settle/found。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 root 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: root 体现了名词化。put down roots = settle/establish，用 put + down + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The tree put down its roots deep into the good earth.
examples.zh: 树把根深深扎入沃土中。

examples.en: The arboreal specimen extended its radicle system profoundly into the fertile soil.
examples.zh: 树把根深深扎入沃土中。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a sail 替代 set sail/hoist a sail/embark。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sail 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: sail 体现了名词化。put up a sail = set sail/embark，用 put + up + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: They put up the sail and the boat went quickly over the water.
examples.zh: 他们扬起帆，船在水面上快速前进。

examples.en: They hoisted the canvas and the vessel moved swiftly across the aquatic surface.
examples.zh: 他们扬起帆，船在水面上快速前进。

basic_explanation: 用 go to school 替代 attend school/study。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 school 是教育机构名词。
ogden_principle: school 体现了名词化。go to school = attend school，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The children go to school every day to learn new things.
examples.zh: 孩子们每天都去学校学习新东西。

examples.en: The youngsters attend the educational institution daily to acquire new knowledge.
examples.zh: 孩子们每天都去学校学习新东西。

basic_explanation: 用 put the scissors to 替代 cut with scissors/snip/trim。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 scissors 是工具名词。
ogden_principle: scissors 体现了名词化。put the scissors to = cut/snip，用 put + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Put the scissors to the paper and cut out a round circle.
examples.zh: 用剪刀在纸上剪出一个圆形。

examples.en: Apply the cutting implement to the paper and excise a circular shape.
examples.zh: 用剪刀在纸上剪出一个圆形。

basic_explanation: 用 put a screw in 替代 screw/fasten/tighten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 screw 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: screw 体现了名词化。put a screw in = screw/fasten，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a screw in the loose board to make it tight again.
examples.zh: 在松动的板上拧一颗螺丝钉把它重新固定好。

examples.en: Insert a threaded fastener into the loose plank to secure it once more.
examples.zh: 在松动的板上拧一颗螺丝钉把它重新固定好。

basic_explanation: 用 put seeds in 替代 sow/plant seeds。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 seed 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: seed 体现了名词化。put seeds in = sow/plant，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put the small seeds in the good earth and give them water every day.
examples.zh: 把种子种进沃土里，每天浇水。

examples.en: Place the diminutive seeds into the fertile soil and irrigate them daily.
examples.zh: 把种子种进沃土里，每天浇水。

basic_explanation: 用 keep sheep 替代 raise sheep/herd ovine animals。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sheep 是农场动物名词。
ogden_principle: sheep 是不可替代的常见家畜名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: They keep sheep on the green hills for their soft wool and meat.
examples.zh: 他们在绿色的山丘上养绵羊来获取柔软的羊毛和羊肉。

examples.en: They raise ovine livestock on the verdant hills for their soft fleece and protein.
examples.zh: 他们在绿色的山丘上养绵羊来获取柔软的羊毛和羊肉。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a shelf 替代 shelve/store/display。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 shelf 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: shelf 体现了名词化。put on a shelf = shelve/store，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the new books on the shelf over the window in the study.
examples.zh: 把新书放在书房窗子上方的书架上。

examples.en: Place the new volumes upon the ledge above the aperture in the study.
examples.zh: 把新书放在书房窗子上方的书架上。

basic_explanation: 用 go by ship 替代 sail/travel by sea。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ship 是水上交通工具名词。
ogden_principle: ship 体现了名词化。go by ship = sail，用核心动词 go + by + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We went by ship across the great sea to a new country.
examples.zh: 我们乘船横渡大海去了一个新的国家。

examples.en: We voyaged via maritime vessel across the vast ocean to a new nation.
examples.zh: 我们乘船横渡大海去了一个新的国家。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a shirt 替代 don a shirt/wear a shirt。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 shirt 是服装名词。
ogden_principle: shirt 体现了名词化。put on a shirt = don a shirt，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on a clean white shirt for the important meeting today.
examples.zh: 穿上干净的白衬衫去参加今天的重要会议。

examples.en: Don a fresh white dress shirt for the significant conference today.
examples.zh: 穿上干净的白衬衫去参加今天的重要会议。

basic_explanation: 用 put on shoes 替代 don shoes/wear footwear。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 shoe 是服饰名词。
ogden_principle: shoe 体现了名词化。put on shoes = don shoes，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on your strong shoes before we go for a long walk in the woods.
examples.zh: 我们去树林里走远路之前穿上结实的鞋子。

examples.en: Don your sturdy footwear prior to our extended hike in the forest.
examples.zh: 我们去树林里走远路之前穿上结实的鞋子。

basic_explanation: 用 put on the skin 替代 apply to skin/touch the surface。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 skin 是身体组织名词。
ogden_principle: skin 体现了名词化。put on the skin = apply topically，用 put + on + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put this soft cream on your dry skin to make it feel better.
examples.zh: 把这种润肤霜涂在干燥的皮肤上让它舒服些。

examples.en: Apply this emollient to your parched dermis to alleviate discomfort.
examples.zh: 把这种润肤霜涂在干燥的皮肤上让它舒服些。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a skirt 替代 don a skirt/wear a skirt。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 skirt 是服装名词。
ogden_principle: skirt 体现了名词化。put on a skirt = don a skirt，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She put on a long blue skirt for the evening meal outside.
examples.zh: 她穿上一条蓝色长裙去参加户外晚餐。

examples.en: She donned an elongated azure garment for the outdoor evening repast.
examples.zh: 她穿上一条蓝色长裙去参加户外晚餐。

basic_explanation: 用 go like a snake 替代 slither/creep/crawl。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 snake 是爬行动物名词。
ogden_principle: snake 是不可替代的常见爬行动物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: A long green snake went quietly through the tall grass by the river.
examples.zh: 一条绿色的长蛇静静地爬过河边的深草丛。

examples.en: An elongated verdant serpent slithered silently through the tall vegetation adjacent to the waterway.
examples.zh: 一条绿色的长蛇静静地爬过河边的深草丛。

basic_explanation: 用 put on socks 替代 don socks/wear hosiery。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sock 是服饰名词。
ogden_principle: sock 体现了名词化。put on socks = don socks，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on warm socks before you put your feet into your cold shoes.
examples.zh: 在把脚伸进冰冷的鞋子之前先穿上暖和的袜子。

examples.en: Don thermal hosiery prior to inserting your feet into your frigid footwear.
examples.zh: 在把脚伸进冰冷的鞋子之前先穿上暖和的袜子。

basic_explanation: 用 put a spade to 替代 dig/spade/excavate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 spade 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: spade 体现了名词化。put a spade to = dig/excavate，用 put + 名词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: Put the spade into the earth and turn it over for planting.
examples.zh: 用铲子翻土准备种植。

examples.en: Insert the digging implement into the soil and invert it for cultivation.
examples.zh: 用铲子翻土准备种植。

basic_explanation: 用 give a sponge 替代 sponge/wipe/clean with sponge。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sponge 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: sponge 体现了名词化。give a sponge = sponge/wipe，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give the table a good sponge with warm water and soap.
examples.zh: 用温水和肥皂好好擦洗一下桌子。

examples.en: Thoroughly wipe the surface with a porous absorbent and warm soapy water.
examples.zh: 用温水和肥皂好好擦洗一下桌子。

basic_explanation: 用 put a spoon in 替代 spoon/scoop/ladle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 spoon 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: spoon 体现了名词化。put a spoon in = scoop/serve，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a spoon in the soup and give it a good stir before you eat.
examples.zh: 用勺子舀一下汤，好好搅拌再喝。

examples.en: Insert a utensil into the broth and stir it thoroughly prior to consumption.
examples.zh: 用勺子舀一下汤，好好搅拌再喝。

basic_explanation: 用 come of a spring 替代 originate from a spring/well up。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 spring 可指季节、弹簧或泉水。
ogden_principle: spring 体现了名词化。come of a spring = well up，用核心动词 come + of + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The flowers come up in the garden every spring after the cold winter.
examples.zh: 每年寒冷的冬天过后，春天花园里就开出花来。

examples.en: The flora emerges in the horticultural space each vernal season following the frigid winter.
examples.zh: 每年寒冷的冬天过后，春天花园里就开出花来。

basic_explanation: 用 put in a square 替代 form into a square/arrange squarely。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 square 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: square 体现了名词化。put in a square = arrange squarely，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put the four chairs in a square round the small table.
examples.zh: 把四把椅子围着小桌子摆成一个正方形。

examples.en: Arrange the four seats in a quadrangle around the diminutive table.
examples.zh: 把四把椅子围着小桌子摆成一个正方形。

basic_explanation: 用 put a stamp on 替代 stamp/postmark/frank。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stamp 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: stamp 体现了名词化。put a stamp on = stamp/postmark，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a stamp on the letter before you put it in the post box.
examples.zh: 在把信投进邮筒之前贴上邮票。

examples.en: Affix postage to the correspondence before depositing it into the collection receptacle.
examples.zh: 在把信投进邮筒之前贴上邮票。

basic_explanation: 用 come out like stars 替代 appear/shine/twinkle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 star 是天体名词。
ogden_principle: star 是不可替代的天文概念名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: The stars came out in the dark night sky one by one.
examples.zh: 星星一颗一颗地出现在黑暗的夜空中。

examples.en: The celestial bodies emerged sequentially in the obsidian nocturnal firmament.
examples.zh: 星星一颗一颗地出现在黑暗的夜空中。

basic_explanation: 用 go to the station 替代 go to the train station/depot。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 station 是交通设施名词。
ogden_principle: station 体现了名词化。go to the station = catch a train，用核心动词 go + to + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We went to the station early to get the first train of the day.
examples.zh: 我们早早去了车站赶当天的第一班火车。

examples.en: We proceeded to the railway terminal early to catch the initial locomotive of the day.
examples.zh: 我们早早去了车站赶当天的第一班火车。

basic_explanation: 用 put out a stem 替代 grow a stem/shoot/sprout。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stem 是植物学名词。
ogden_principle: stem 体现了名词化。put out a stem = sprout/grow，用 put + out + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The plant put out a strong green stem with a flower on top.
examples.zh: 植物长出了一根结实的绿色茎，顶端开了一朵花。

examples.en: The botanical specimen produced a robust verdant stalk with a blossom at its apex.
examples.zh: 植物长出了一根结实的绿色茎，顶端开了一朵花。

basic_explanation: 用 put a stick in 替代 insert a stick/prop/stake。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stick 是常见物体名词。
ogden_principle: stick 体现了名词化。put a stick in = stake/prop，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a long stick in the earth to help the young plant grow straight.
examples.zh: 在土里插一根长棍帮助小植物直立生长。

examples.en: Insert an elongated rod into the soil to assist the young plant in growing vertically.
examples.zh: 在土里插一根长棍帮助小植物直立生长。

basic_explanation: 用 put on stockings 替代 don stockings/wear hosiery。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stocking 是服饰名词。
ogden_principle: stocking 体现了名词化。put on stockings = don stockings，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She put on warm stockings under her dress for the cold day.
examples.zh: 她在裙子下面穿上了暖和的长筒袜来抵御寒冷。

examples.en: She donned thermal hosiery beneath her garment for the frigid day.
examples.zh: 她在裙子下面穿上了暖和的长筒袜来抵御寒冷。

basic_explanation: 用 have a pain in the stomach 替代 have a stomachache/digestive discomfort。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stomach 是身体器官名词。
ogden_principle: stomach 体现了名词化。have a pain in the stomach = have a stomachache，用 have + 名词 + in + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: He had a bad pain in his stomach after eating too much cake.
examples.zh: 他蛋糕吃多了之后胃疼得厉害。

examples.en: He experienced severe discomfort in his gastric region after consuming excessive confection.
examples.zh: 他蛋糕吃多了之后胃疼得厉害。

basic_explanation: 用 put in store 替代 store/stockpile/keep for later。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 store 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: store 体现了名词化。put in store = store/stockpile，用 put + 介词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the extra food in store for the long cold winter months ahead.
examples.zh: 把多余的食物储存起来以备接下来漫长的寒冬。

examples.en: Stockpile the surplus provisions for the extended frigid winter months forthcoming.
examples.zh: 把多余的食物储存起来以备接下来漫长的寒冬。

basic_explanation: 用 go down the street 替代 walk along the street/travel the road。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 street 是城市道路名词。
ogden_principle: street 体现了名词化。go down the street = walk，用核心动词 go + down + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: We went down the narrow street looking for the old book store.
examples.zh: 我们沿着狭窄的街道寻找那家旧书店。

examples.en: We traversed the constricted thoroughfare searching for the antiquated book establishment.
examples.zh: 我们沿着狭窄的街道寻找那家旧书店。

basic_explanation: 用 come up like the sun 替代 rise/appear/shine。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sun 是不可替代的天体名词。
ogden_principle: sun 是不可替代的自然天体名词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: The sun came up over the mountains and the day got warm and bright.
examples.zh: 太阳从山上升起，天变得温暖而明亮。

examples.en: The solar orb ascended above the peaks and the day became warm and luminous.
examples.zh: 太阳从山上升起，天变得温暖而明亮。

basic_explanation: 用 put on the table 替代 table/present/propose。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 table 可指家具或数据表。
ogden_principle: table 体现了名词化。put on the table = present/propose，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the plates and glasses out on the table for the evening meal.
examples.zh: 把盘子和玻璃杯摆到桌子上准备晚餐。

examples.en: Set the dishes and tumblers upon the dining surface for the evening repast.
examples.zh: 把盘子和玻璃杯摆到桌子上准备晚餐。

basic_explanation: 用 put a tail on 替代 tail/follow/track。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tail 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: tail 体现了名词化。put a tail on = follow/track，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: The happy dog gave a wave of its tail when it saw its owner.
examples.zh: 快乐的狗见到主人时摇了摇尾巴。

examples.en: The joyful canine wagged its caudal appendage upon seeing its proprietor.
examples.zh: 快乐的狗见到主人时摇了摇尾巴。

basic_explanation: 用 put a thread through 替代 thread/string/lace。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 thread 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: thread 体现了名词化。put a thread through = thread/lace，用 put + 名词 + through 替代动词。

examples.en: Put a thread through the hole in the needle and start to sew.
examples.zh: 把线穿过针孔然后开始缝。

examples.en: Pass a filament through the aperture in the sewing implement and commence stitching.
examples.zh: 把线穿过针孔然后开始缝。

basic_explanation: 用 have a pain in the throat 替代 have a sore throat/throat discomfort。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 throat 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: throat 体现了名词化。have a pain in the throat = have a sore throat，用 have + 名词 + in + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: She had a bad pain in her throat and could not say a word.
examples.zh: 她喉咙疼得厉害，一句话也说不出来。

examples.en: She experienced severe discomfort in her pharynx and could not utter a syllable.
examples.zh: 她喉咙疼得厉害，一句话也说不出来。

basic_explanation: 用 put a thumb up 替代 approve/signal okay/indicate good。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 thumb 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: thumb 体现了名词化。put a thumb up = approve，用 put + 名词 + up 替代动词。

examples.en: He put his thumb up to show that everything was good and fine.
examples.zh: 他竖起拇指表示一切都好。

examples.en: He raised his pollex to indicate that everything was satisfactory.
examples.zh: 他竖起拇指表示一切都好。

basic_explanation: 用 give a ticket to 替代 ticket/issue a pass/admit。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ticket 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: ticket 体现了名词化。give a ticket to = admit/issue a pass，用 give + 名词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Please give me a ticket for the last train to London tonight.
examples.zh: 请给我一张今晚去伦敦的末班火车票。

examples.en: Please provide me with a pass for the final locomotive to London this evening.
examples.zh: 请给我一张今晚去伦敦的末班火车票。

basic_explanation: 用 put a toe in 替代 dip a toe/test/试探。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 toe 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: toe 体现了名词化。put a toe in = test the water，用 put + 名词 + in 替代动词短语。

examples.en: She put a toe in the cold water before she went in for a swim.
examples.zh: 她先用脚趾试探了一下冷水才下水游泳。

examples.en: She dipped a digit into the frigid liquid before immersing herself for a swim.
examples.zh: 她先用脚趾试探了一下冷水才下水游泳。

basic_explanation: 用 put out the tongue 替代 stick out the tongue/protrude。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tongue 可指舌头或语言。
ogden_principle: tongue 体现了名词化。put out the tongue = protrude the tongue，用 put + out + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The small child put out its tongue at the doctor as a funny game.
examples.zh: 小孩对着医生吐舌头当做好玩的游戏。

examples.en: The youngster protruded its lingual organ at the physician as an amusing game.
examples.zh: 小孩对着医生吐舌头当做好玩的游戏。

basic_explanation: 用 have a pain in a tooth 替代 have a toothache/dental pain。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tooth 是身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: tooth 体现了名词化。have a pain in a tooth = have a toothache，用 have + 名词 + in + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: He had a bad pain in his tooth and went to see the doctor.
examples.zh: 他牙疼得厉害，去看了医生。

examples.en: He experienced severe discomfort in his dental structure and sought medical consultation.
examples.zh: 他牙疼得厉害，去看了医生。

basic_explanation: 用 go into town 替代 go to the town center/visit town。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 town 是聚居地名名词。
ogden_principle: town 体现了名词化。go into town = visit the town center，用核心动词 go + into + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We went into town on the bus to get some new clothes for the summer.
examples.zh: 我们坐公交去镇上买夏天的衣服。

examples.en: We traveled to the municipality via omnibus to procure some new garments for the estival season.
examples.zh: 我们坐公交去镇上买夏天的衣服。

basic_explanation: 用 go by train 替代 take the train/travel by rail。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 train 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: train 体现了名词化。go by train = travel by rail，用核心动词 go + by + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We went by fast train from one great city to another in just one day.
examples.zh: 我们乘快车一天之内就从一个大城市到了另一个大城市。

examples.en: We traveled via high-speed locomotive from one metropolis to another within a single day.
examples.zh: 我们乘快车一天之内就从一个大城市到了另一个大城市。

basic_explanation: 用 put on a tray 替代 serve on a tray/carry on a platter。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tray 是容器名词。
ogden_principle: tray 体现了名词化。put on a tray = serve/carry，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put the cups and plates on a tray to take them to the garden.
examples.zh: 把杯子和盘子放在托盘上端到花园里去。

examples.en: Arrange the cups and dishes upon a serving platter to convey them to the garden.
examples.zh: 把杯子和盘子放在托盘上端到花园里去。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a tree 替代 plant a tree/erect a tree。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tree 是植物学基础名词。
ogden_principle: tree 是不可替代的自然植物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: They put up a young tree in the garden to give shade in the summer.
examples.zh: 他们在花园里种了一棵小树以便夏天遮阴。

examples.en: They planted a sapling in the garden to provide shade during the summer months.
examples.zh: 他们在花园里种了一棵小树以便夏天遮阴。

basic_explanation: 用 put on trousers 替代 don trousers/wear pants。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 trousers 是服装名词。
ogden_principle: trousers 体现了名词化。put on trousers = don trousers，用 put + on + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Put on your best trousers for the important dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 穿上你最好的裤子去参加今晚重要的晚宴。

examples.en: Don your finest legwear for the significant dinner engagement this evening.
examples.zh: 穿上你最好的裤子去参加今晚重要的晚宴。

basic_explanation: 用 put up an umbrella 替代 open an umbrella/unfurl。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 umbrella 是日常用品名词。
ogden_principle: umbrella 体现了名词化。put up an umbrella = open an umbrella，用 put + up + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put up your umbrella because the rain is coming down hard now.
examples.zh: 把伞撑开，雨下大了。

examples.en: Open your rain shield as the precipitation is intensifying now.
examples.zh: 把伞撑开，雨下大了。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a wall 替代 build a wall/erect a barrier。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wall 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wall 体现了名词化。put up a wall = build/erect a wall，用 put + up + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: They put up a high stone wall round the garden for privacy.
examples.zh: 他们在花园周围砌了一道高高的石墙来保护隐私。

examples.en: They erected an elevated masonry barrier around the garden for seclusion.
examples.zh: 他们在花园周围砌了一道高高的石墙来保护隐私。

basic_explanation: 用 keep a watch on 替代 watch/monitor/guard。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 watch 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: watch 体现了名词化。keep a watch on = watch/monitor，用 keep + 名词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: Keep a close watch on the baby while she is playing near the water.
examples.zh: 宝宝在水边玩耍时要密切看护好她。

examples.en: Maintain vigilant supervision of the infant while she plays near the aquatic area.
examples.zh: 宝宝在水边玩耍时要密切看护好她。

basic_explanation: 用 put wheels on 替代 fit with wheels/mobilize。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wheel 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wheel 体现了名词化。put wheels on = mobilize/fit wheels，用 put + 名词 + on 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put new wheels on the old cart so it goes better on the road.
examples.zh: 给旧手推车装上新的轮子，让它在路上跑得更好。

examples.en: Install new circular components onto the antiquated cart so it travels better on the thoroughfare.
examples.zh: 给旧手推车装上新的轮子，让它在路上跑得更好。

basic_explanation: 用 give a whip 替代 whip/lash/strike。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 whip 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: whip 体现了名词化。give a whip = whip/lash，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The driver gave the horse a light whip to make it go faster.
examples.zh: 车夫轻轻挥了一下鞭子让马跑快些。

examples.en: The coachman flicked the equine lightly with a lash to increase its pace.
examples.zh: 车夫轻轻挥了一下鞭子让马跑快些。

basic_explanation: 用 give a whistle 替代 whistle/blow/piping。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 whistle 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: whistle 体现了名词化。give a whistle = whistle，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The guard gave a loud whistle to let everyone know the train was coming.
examples.zh: 列车员吹响响亮的哨子告诉大家火车来了。

examples.en: The conductor emitted a resonant whistle to notify everyone of the approaching locomotive.
examples.zh: 列车员吹响响亮的哨子告诉大家火车来了。

basic_explanation: 用 put up a window 替代 install a window/fit a window。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 window 是建筑基础名词。
ogden_principle: window 体现了名词化。put up a window = install a window，用 put + up + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: They put up a new window in the bedroom to let in more morning light.
examples.zh: 他们在卧室装了一扇新窗户让更多晨光进来。

examples.en: They installed a new aperture in the sleeping chamber to admit more morning illumination.
examples.zh: 他们在卧室装了一扇新窗户让更多晨光进来。

basic_explanation: 用 put out wings 替代 spread wings/extend/fly。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wing 是鸟类身体部位名词。
ogden_principle: wing 体现了名词化。put out wings = spread wings/fly，用 put + out + 名词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The bird put out its great wings and went up into the blue sky.
examples.zh: 鸟展开巨大的翅膀飞向蓝天。

examples.en: The avian extended its vast pinions and ascended into the azure firmament.
examples.zh: 鸟展开巨大的翅膀飞向蓝天。

basic_explanation: 用 put a wire through 替代 wire/connect/thread。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wire 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wire 体现了名词化。put a wire through = wire/connect，用 put + 名词 + through 替代动词。

examples.en: Put the wire through the small hole and make a strong connection.
examples.zh: 把电线穿过小孔接好牢固的连接。

examples.en: Thread the metallic conductor through the small aperture and establish a secure connection.
examples.zh: 把电线穿过小孔接好牢固的连接。

basic_explanation: 用 go like a worm 替代 wriggle/crawl/slither。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 worm 是常见小动物名词。
ogden_principle: worm 是不可替代的常见小生物名词。Basic English 保留这类核心可图示概念词。

examples.en: A small worm came up out of the wet earth after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后一条小虫子从湿土里钻了出来。

examples.en: A diminutive annelid emerged from the moist soil following the precipitation.
examples.zh: 雨后一条小虫子从湿土里钻了出来。

basic_explanation: 用 be able to 替代 can/be capable of/have the skill to。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 able 是最基础的能力形容词。
ogden_principle: able 体现了名词化。be able to = can，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代情态动词。这是 Basic English 替代 can 的标准方式。

examples.en: She is able to do the hard work without any help from others.
examples.zh: 她能够在没有任何帮助的情况下完成这项艰巨工作。

examples.en: She is capable of performing the difficult task without any assistance.
examples.zh: 她能够在没有任何帮助的情况下完成这项艰巨工作。

basic_explanation: 用 have an acid taste 替代 be acidic/sour/tart。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 acid 可作名词也可作形容词。
ogden_principle: acid 体现了名词化。have an acid taste = be acidic，用 have + 名词 + 名词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: The fruit had a sharp acid taste that made my mouth go dry.
examples.zh: 那个水果有强烈的酸味，让我嘴巴都干了。

examples.en: The fruit possessed a pungent acidic flavor that caused my oral cavity to desiccate.
examples.zh: 那个水果有强烈的酸味，让我嘴巴都干了。

basic_explanation: 用 get angry 替代 become angry/lose temper/fume。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 angry 是基础情感形容词。
ogden_principle: angry 体现了名词化。get angry = become angry，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: He got very angry when he saw the damage to his new car.
examples.zh: 看到新车的损坏他非常生气。

examples.en: He became extremely irate upon witnessing the destruction to his new automobile.
examples.zh: 看到新车的损坏他非常生气。

basic_explanation: 用 go by itself 替代 be automatic/self-operating。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 automatic 是技术形容词。
ogden_principle: automatic 体现了名词化。go by itself = be automatic，用核心动词 go + by + itself 替代形容词结构。

examples.en: The door goes shut by itself when you walk away from it.
examples.zh: 你走开时门会自动关上。

examples.en: The entrance closes automatically when you walk away from it.
examples.zh: 你走开时门会自动关上。

basic_explanation: 用 be beautiful 替代 be pretty/lovely/stunning/gorgeous。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 beautiful 是最通用的赞美形容词。
ogden_principle: beautiful 入选因为它覆盖了所有视觉和心灵美感。Basic English 用它替代 pretty、gorgeous、stunning 等所有赞美形容词。

examples.en: The garden was beautiful with all the flowers in full open bloom.
examples.zh: 花园里群花盛放，美不胜收。

examples.en: The garden was stunning with all the blossoms in full flower.
examples.zh: 花园里群花盛放，美不胜收。

basic_explanation: 用 go black 替代 turn black/darken。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 black 是基础颜色形容词。
ogden_principle: black 体现了名词化。go black = darken，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The sky went black as the storm came over the town.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临时天空变黑了。

examples.en: The firmament darkened as the tempest approached the municipality.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临时天空变黑了。

basic_explanation: 用 come to a boil 替代 boil/reach boiling point。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 boiling 是温度形容词。
ogden_principle: boiling 体现了名词化。come to a boil = boil，用核心动词 come + to + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The water came to a boil and was ready for the tea.
examples.zh: 水烧开了，可以泡茶了。

examples.en: The liquid reached its boiling point and was ready for the infusion.
examples.zh: 水烧开了，可以泡茶了。

basic_explanation: 用 give off a bright light 替代 shine/brighten/illuminate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bright 可指光线或智力。
ogden_principle: bright 体现了名词化。give off a bright light = shine，用 give + off + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The sun gave off a bright light that made the whole room warm and gold.
examples.zh: 太阳发出明亮的光芒，使整个房间都温暖而金光闪闪。

examples.en: The solar orb emitted brilliant illumination that rendered the entire chamber warm and golden.
examples.zh: 太阳发出明亮的光芒，使整个房间都温暖而金光闪闪。

basic_explanation: 用 get broken 替代 break/shatter/fracture。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 broken 是状态形容词。
ogden_principle: broken 体现了名词化。get broken = break，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The glass got broken when it fell off the table onto the stone floor.
examples.zh: 杯子从桌上掉到石头地板上摔碎了。

examples.en: The glass shattered when it tumbled from the table onto the stone surface.
examples.zh: 杯子从桌上掉到石头地板上摔碎了。

basic_explanation: 用 go brown 替代 turn brown/become brown。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 brown 是基础颜色形容词。
ogden_principle: brown 体现了名词化。go brown = turn brown，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The leaves on the trees go brown and fall in the autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天树叶变黄褐色后落下来。

examples.en: The foliage on the arboreal specimens turns brown and descends during the autumnal season.
examples.zh: 秋天树叶变黄褐色后落下来。

basic_explanation: 用 go for a cheap price 替代 be cheap/affordable/inexpensive。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cheap 是价格形容词。
ogden_principle: cheap 体现了名词化。go for a cheap price = be cheap，用核心动词 go + for + 名词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: You can get good food at a cheap price in the market today.
examples.zh: 今天市场上可以以便宜的价格买到好食物。

examples.en: You can obtain quality provisions at an affordable cost in the marketplace today.
examples.zh: 今天市场上可以以便宜的价格买到好食物。

basic_explanation: 用 made by chemical change 替代 synthetic/chemically produced。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 chemical 是科学形容词。
ogden_principle: chemical 体现了名词化。made by chemical change = synthetic，用 made + by + 名词替代形容词。

examples.en: The new material was made by a chemical change in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 这种新材料是在实验室里通过化学变化制成的。

examples.en: The novel substance was synthesized through a chemical process in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 这种新材料是在实验室里通过化学变化制成的。

basic_explanation: 用 be the chief of 替代 lead/head/be the main person。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 chief 可作名词也可作形容词。
ogden_principle: chief 体现了名词化。be the chief of = lead/head，用 be + 名词 + of 替代动词。

examples.en: She is the chief person in the office and makes all the important decisions.
examples.zh: 她是办公室的主管，做出所有重要决定。

examples.en: She is the principal executive in the office and makes all the crucial determinations.
examples.zh: 她是办公室的主管，做出所有重要决定。

basic_explanation: 用 give a good clean 替代 clean/scrub/sanitize。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 clean 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: clean 体现了名词化。give a good clean = clean/scrub，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: Give the kitchen floor a good clean with soap and hot water.
examples.zh: 用肥皂和热水好好清洁一下厨房地板。

examples.en: Thoroughly cleanse the culinary surface with detergent and heated water.
examples.zh: 用肥皂和热水好好清洁一下厨房地板。

basic_explanation: 用 make clear 替代 clarify/explain/elucidate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 clear 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: clear 体现了名词化。make clear = clarify，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Please make it clear what you want us to do next.
examples.zh: 请说清楚你接下来想让我们做什么。

examples.en: Please clarify what you wish us to undertake subsequently.
examples.zh: 请说清楚你接下来想让我们做什么。

basic_explanation: 用 have in common 替代 share/be similar/be shared。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 common 是基础形容词。
ogden_principle: common 体现了名词化。have in common = share，用 have + 介词 + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: We all have a love of good music in common with one another.
examples.zh: 我们都共同热爱好音乐。

examples.en: We all share a mutual appreciation for quality music.
examples.zh: 我们都共同热爱好音乐。

basic_explanation: 用 make complex 替代 complicate/make difficult。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 complex 是难度形容词。
ogden_principle: complex 体现了名词化。make complex = complicate，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Do not make the work complex when it can be done simply.
examples.zh: 能力简单完成的事不要搞复杂了。

examples.en: Do not complicate the task when it can be accomplished simply.
examples.zh: 能力简单完成的事不要搞复杂了。

basic_explanation: 用 be conscious of 替代 be aware/notice/realize。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 conscious 是认知形容词。
ogden_principle: conscious 体现了名词化。be conscious of = notice/realize，用 be + 形容词 + of 替代动词。

examples.en: He was conscious of a strange sound coming from the other room.
examples.zh: 他察觉到另一个房间传来奇怪的声音。

examples.en: He was aware of an unusual noise emanating from the adjacent chamber.
examples.zh: 他察觉到另一个房间传来奇怪的声音。

basic_explanation: 用 give a cut 替代 cut/slice/gash。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cut 可作名词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: cut 体现了名词化。give a cut = cut/slice，用 give + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He gave his finger a bad cut while using the sharp knife.
examples.zh: 他用锋利的刀时把手指割了一道深口子。

examples.en: He sustained a severe laceration on his digit while using the sharp blade.
examples.zh: 他用锋利的刀时把手指割了一道深口子。

basic_explanation: 用 go deep into 替代 delve/penetrate/probe。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 deep 是空间和抽象形容词。
ogden_principle: deep 体现了名词化。go deep into = delve/penetrate，用核心动词 go + 形容词 + into 替代动词。

examples.en: We went deep into the dark woods and got lost for a time.
examples.zh: 我们走进密林深处，一度迷了路。

examples.en: We penetrated profoundly into the dark forest and became disoriented temporarily.
examples.zh: 我们走进密林深处，一度迷了路。

basic_explanation: 用 be dependent on 替代 depend on/rely on/need。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dependent 是关系形容词。
ogden_principle: dependent 体现了名词化。be dependent on = depend on，用 be + 形容词 + on 替代动词。

examples.en: The young baby is completely dependent on its mother for food and care.
examples.zh: 小婴儿完全依赖母亲提供食物和照料。

examples.en: The infant is entirely reliant upon its maternal parent for nourishment and care.
examples.zh: 小婴儿完全依赖母亲提供食物和照料。

basic_explanation: 用 get up early 替代 rise early/wake at dawn。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 early 是时间形容词。
ogden_principle: early 体现了名词化。get up early = rise early，用核心动词 get + up + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We got up early to see the sun come up over the sea.
examples.zh: 我们早起去看太阳从海上升起。

examples.en: We arose at dawn to witness the solar orb ascend above the ocean.
examples.zh: 我们早起去看太阳从海上升起。

basic_explanation: 用 go back like elastic 替代 stretch and return/be flexible。
standard: 标准英语中 elastic 是物理性质形容词。
ogden_principle: elastic 体现了名词化。go back like elastic = be flexible，用核心动词 go + back + like + 名词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: The band is made of elastic and goes back to its first shape when you let go.
examples.zh: 这条带子是弹性的，你一松手它就会弹回原状。

examples.en: The band is composed of elastic material and returns to its original shape when released.
examples.zh: 这条带子是弹性的，你一松手它就会弹回原状。

basic_explanation: 用 go by electric power 替代 be electric/powered by electricity。
standard: 标准英语中 electric 是科技形容词。
ogden_principle: electric 体现了名词化。go by electric power = be electric，用核心动词 go + by + 名词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: The new train goes by electric power and is very quiet and clean.
examples.zh: 新火车用电力驱动，非常安静和清洁。

examples.en: The new locomotive operates on electrical power and is remarkably quiet and clean.
examples.zh: 新火车用电力驱动，非常安静和清洁。

basic_explanation: 用 be equal to 替代 equal/match/be the same as。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 equal 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: equal 体现了名词化。be equal to = equal/match，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: All persons are equal under the law of the land.
examples.zh: 法律面前人人平等。

examples.en: All individuals are equal under the legislation of the nation.
examples.zh: 法律面前人人平等。

basic_explanation: 用 get fat 替代 become fat/gain weight。
standard: 标准英语中 fat 是体型形容词。
ogden_principle: fat 体现了名词化。get fat = become fat，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: If you eat too much and do not exercise, you may get fat.
examples.zh: 如果吃得太多又不锻炼，你可能会变胖。

examples.en: If you consume excessively and do not exercise, you may become overweight.
examples.zh: 如果吃得太多又不锻炼，你可能会变胖。

basic_explanation: 用 make fertile 替代 fertilize/enrich/cultivate。
standard: 标准英语中 fertile 是农业形容词。
ogden_principle: fertile 体现了名词化。make fertile = fertilize，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The farmer put good things in the earth to make the land fertile again.
examples.zh: 农民在土里施加了好的东西来让土地再次肥沃起来。

examples.en: The agriculturalist added beneficial substances to the soil to make the land fertile once more.
examples.zh: 农民在土里施加了好的东西来让土地再次肥沃起来。

basic_explanation: 用 come first 替代 be first/lead/win。
standard: 标准英语中 first 是顺序形容词。
ogden_principle: first 体现了名词化。come first = lead/win，用核心动词 come + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: She came first in the race and everyone gave a loud cheer for her.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中得了第一名，大家都为她大声欢呼。

examples.en: She finished first in the competition and everyone cheered loudly for her.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中得了第一名，大家都为她大声欢呼。

basic_explanation: 用 make fixed 替代 fix/secure/attach permanently。
standard: 标准英语中 fixed 是状态形容词。
ogden_principle: fixed 体现了名词化。make fixed = fix/secure，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the shelf fixed to the wall with strong screws so it is safe.
examples.zh: 用结实的螺丝把架子固定在墙上以确保安全。

examples.en: Secure the shelf to the wall with robust screws so it remains stable.
examples.zh: 用结实的螺丝把架子固定在墙上以确保安全。

basic_explanation: 用 make flat 替代 flatten/level/smooth。
standard: 标准英语中 flat 是形状形容词。
ogden_principle: flat 体现了名词化。make flat = flatten/level，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the ground flat before you put up the new building on it.
examples.zh: 在建造新楼之前先把地面整平。

examples.en: Level the ground before you erect the new structure upon it.
examples.zh: 在建造新楼之前先把地面整平。

basic_explanation: 用 set free 替代 free/release/liberate。
standard: 标准英语中 free 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: free 体现了名词化。set free = free/release，用 set + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: They set the small bird free from the cage and it flew away into the sky.
examples.zh: 他们把关在笼中的小鸟放了出来，小鸟飞向了天空。

examples.en: They released the small bird from its enclosure and it soared into the firmament.
examples.zh: 他们把关在笼中的小鸟放了出来，小鸟飞向了天空。

basic_explanation: 用 go frequently to 替代 visit often/frequent。
standard: 标准英语中 frequent 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: frequent 体现了名词化。go frequently to = frequent/visit often，用核心动词 go + 副词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: She makes frequent trips to the city to see her old mother there.
examples.zh: 她频繁地进城去看望她年迈的母亲。

examples.en: She makes regular journeys to the metropolis to visit her elderly mother.
examples.zh: 她频繁地进城去看望她年迈的母亲。

basic_explanation: 用 make full 替代 fill/load/stock。
standard: 标准英语中 full 是容量形容词。
ogden_principle: full 体现了名词化。make full = fill，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the water glass full to the top with cold fresh water.
examples.zh: 把水杯倒满新鲜的冷水。

examples.en: Fill the drinking vessel completely with cold fresh water.
examples.zh: 把水杯倒满新鲜的冷水。

basic_explanation: 用 in general 替代 generally/typically/usually。
standard: 标准英语中 general 是概括形容词。
ogden_principle: general 体现了名词化。in general = generally，用介词 + 形容词替代副词。

examples.en: In general, the weather in this part of the country is warm and dry.
examples.zh: 总体而言，这个国家的这一地区天气温暖干燥。

examples.en: Generally, the climate in this region of the country is warm and arid.
examples.zh: 总体而言，这个国家的这一地区天气温暖干燥。

basic_explanation: 用 be good at 替代 excel/skilled/proficient。
standard: 标准英语中 good 是最通用的正面评价形容词。
ogden_principle: good 体现了名词化。be good at = excel at，用 be + 形容词 + at 替代动词。

examples.en: She is very good at making new friends wherever she goes.
examples.zh: 她无论走到哪里都很擅长交新朋友。

examples.en: She excels at establishing new friendships wherever she travels.
examples.zh: 她无论走到哪里都很擅长交新朋友。

basic_explanation: 用 be great at 替代 be excellent/outstanding。
standard: 标准英语中 great 是强度形容词。
ogden_principle: great 体现了名词化。be great at = excel at，用 be + 形容词 + at 替代动词。

examples.en: He is great at playing the piano and gives shows to large crowds.
examples.zh: 他弹钢琴很出色，给大批观众表演过。

examples.en: He is outstanding at performing on the piano and gives concerts to large audiences.
examples.zh: 他弹钢琴很出色，给大批观众表演过。

basic_explanation: 用 go grey 替代 turn grey/graying。
standard: 标准英语中 grey 是颜色形容词。
ogden_principle: grey 体现了名词化。go grey = turn grey，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: His hair started to go grey when he was still quite young.
examples.zh: 他还很年轻的时候头发就开始变灰白了。

examples.en: His hair began to turn silver when he was still quite youthful.
examples.zh: 他还很年轻的时候头发就开始变灰白了。

basic_explanation: 用 put up hanging 替代 hang/suspend/dangle。
standard: 标准英语中 hanging 是状态形容词。
ogden_principle: hanging 体现了名词化。put up hanging = hang/suspend，用 put + up + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Put up the hanging light over the middle of the dinner table.
examples.zh: 把吊灯挂在餐桌正上方。

examples.en: Suspend the light fixture over the center of the dining table.
examples.zh: 把吊灯挂在餐桌正上方。

basic_explanation: 用 make happy 替代 please/delight/cheer。
standard: 标准英语中 happy 是情感形容词。
ogden_principle: happy 体现了名词化。make happy = please/delight，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The good news made everyone in the house very happy and full of joy.
examples.zh: 好消息让屋子里的每个人都感到非常快乐和充满喜悦。

examples.en: The positive tidings rendered everyone in the dwelling extremely joyful and elated.
examples.zh: 好消息让屋子里的每个人都感到非常快乐和充满喜悦。

basic_explanation: 用 make hard 替代 harden/difficult/toughen。
standard: 标准英语中 hard 是质地和难度形容词。
ogden_principle: hard 体现了名词化。make hard = harden，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The cold made the wet ground as hard as stone overnight.
examples.zh: 寒冷使湿地面一夜之间变得硬如石头。

examples.en: The frigid temperature rendered the moist ground as solid as rock overnight.
examples.zh: 寒冷使湿地面一夜之间变得硬如石头。

basic_explanation: 用 keep healthy 替代 stay healthy/maintain health。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 healthy 是身体状态形容词。
ogden_principle: healthy 体现了名词化。keep healthy = stay healthy，用 keep + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Eat good food and take exercise to keep healthy and strong all your life.
examples.zh: 吃好的食物和锻炼身体，让你一生都保持健康强壮。

examples.en: Consume nutritious food and exercise to remain healthy and robust throughout your life.
examples.zh: 吃好的食物和锻炼身体，让你一生都保持健康强壮。

basic_explanation: 用 go high 替代 rise/climb/ascend。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 high 是高度形容词。
ogden_principle: high 体现了名词化。go high = rise/ascend，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The plane went high into the clouds until we could not see it anymore.
examples.zh: 飞机飞到高高的云层中，直到我们看不见它。

examples.en: The aircraft ascended high into the clouds until we could no longer observe it.
examples.zh: 飞机飞到高高的云层中，直到我们看不见它。

basic_explanation: 用 make hollow 替代 hollow out/excavate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 hollow 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: hollow 体现了名词化。make hollow = hollow out，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: They made the inside of the old tree hollow to make a small room for playing.
examples.zh: 他们把老树的内部挖空做成了一个小游戏室。

examples.en: They excavated the interior of the ancient tree to create a small play space.
examples.zh: 他们把老树的内部挖空做成了一个小游戏室。

basic_explanation: 用 be of great importance 替代 be important/matter/signify。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 important 是价值判断形容词。
ogden_principle: important 体现了名词化。be of great importance = matter greatly，用 be + of + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: It is of great importance to be on time for the meeting tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天准时参加会议非常重要。

examples.en: It is crucial to be punctual for the conference tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天准时参加会议非常重要。

basic_explanation: 用 be kind to 替代 treat well/be nice to。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 kind 是性格形容词。
ogden_principle: kind 体现了名词化。be kind to = treat kindly，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: It is good to be kind to animals and take care of them well.
examples.zh: 善待动物并好好照顾它们是一件好事。

examples.en: It is virtuous to be compassionate toward animals and care for them properly.
examples.zh: 善待动物并好好照顾它们是一件好事。

basic_explanation: 用 be like 替代 resemble/be similar to。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 like 是比较介词和形容词。
ogden_principle: like 体现了名词化。be like = resemble，用 be + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: She is very like her mother in the way she talks and smiles.
examples.zh: 她说话和微笑的方式很像她妈妈。

examples.en: She closely resembles her mother in her manner of speaking and smiling.
examples.zh: 她说话和微笑的方式很像她妈妈。

basic_explanation: 用 be living 替代 be alive/live/exist。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 living 是生命状态形容词。
ogden_principle: living 体现了名词化。be living = be alive，用 be + 形容词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: The old tree is still living and puts out new leaves every spring.
examples.zh: 那棵老树仍然活着，每年春天都长出新叶。

examples.en: The ancient arboreal specimen is still alive and produces new foliage each spring.
examples.zh: 那棵老树仍然活着，每年春天都长出新叶。

basic_explanation: 用 make long 替代 lengthen/extend/prolong。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 long 是长度形容词。
ogden_principle: long 体现了名词化。make long = lengthen，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Do not make the talk too long because everyone is tired and wants to go home.
examples.zh: 别把讲话拖得太长，大家都累了想回家了。

examples.en: Do not prolong the speech excessively because everyone is fatigued and wishes to go home.
examples.zh: 别把讲话拖得太长，大家都累了想回家了。

basic_explanation: 用 be male 替代 be masculine/of the male sex。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 male 是性别形容词。
ogden_principle: male 是不可替代的生物学基础形容词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: The male bird has bright blue feathers to get the attention of the female.
examples.zh: 雄鸟有鲜艳的蓝色羽毛来吸引雌鸟。

examples.en: The male avian possesses vibrant azure plumage to attract the female.
examples.zh: 雄鸟有鲜艳的蓝色羽毛来吸引雌鸟。

basic_explanation: 用 get married to 替代 marry/wed/take as spouse。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 married 是婚姻状态形容词。
ogden_principle: married 体现了名词化。get married to = marry，用核心动词 get + 形容词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: They got married in a small church near the sea with all their friends there.
examples.zh: 他们在一个海边的小教堂里结了婚，所有的朋友都在场。

examples.en: They wed in a small chapel near the ocean with all their friends present.
examples.zh: 他们在一个海边的小教堂里结了婚，所有的朋友都在场。

basic_explanation: 用 made of solid material 替代 tangible/physical/substantial。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 material 可作名词也可作形容词。
ogden_principle: material 体现了名词化。made of solid material = tangible，用 made + of + 名词替代形容词。

examples.en: The table is made of a strong material that will last for many years.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是用坚固的材料制成的，能用很多年。

examples.en: The table is constructed from a durable substance that will endure for many years.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是用坚固的材料制成的，能用很多年。

basic_explanation: 用 give medical help 替代 treat medically/provide healthcare。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 medical 是健康领域形容词。
ogden_principle: medical 体现了名词化。give medical help = treat，用 give + 形容词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: The doctor gave medical help to the sick child all through the night.
examples.zh: 医生整夜都在给生病的孩子提供医疗救治。

examples.en: The physician provided medical care to the ill child throughout the night.
examples.zh: 医生整夜都在给生病的孩子提供医疗救治。

basic_explanation: 用 be in the military 替代 serve in the army/be a soldier。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 military 是国防形容词。
ogden_principle: military 体现了名词化。be in the military = serve in the army，用 be + 介词 + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: He was in the military for ten years and went to many far places.
examples.zh: 他在军队服役了十年，去了许多遥远的地方。

examples.en: He served in the armed forces for a decade and traveled to many distant locations.
examples.zh: 他在军队服役了十年，去了许多遥远的地方。

basic_explanation: 用 come natural to 替代 be innate/instinctive/inborn。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 natural 是本质形容词。
ogden_principle: natural 体现了名词化。come natural to = be innate，用核心动词 come + 形容词 + to 替代形容词结构。

examples.en: Playing music came natural to her even when she was very young.
examples.zh: 她很小的时候音乐就对她来说是很自然的事。

examples.en: Performing music came naturally to her even at a very young age.
examples.zh: 她很小的时候音乐就对她来说是很自然的事。

basic_explanation: 用 be necessary for 替代 require/need/be essential。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 necessary 是需求形容词。
ogden_principle: necessary 体现了名词化。be necessary for = require，用 be + 形容词 + for 替代动词。

examples.en: Water is necessary for all living things to keep alive and well.
examples.zh: 水是所有生物存活和健康所必需的。

examples.en: Water is essential for all organisms to survive and thrive.
examples.zh: 水是所有生物存活和健康所必需的。

basic_explanation: 用 make new again 替代 renew/restore/refresh。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 new 是状态形容词。
ogden_principle: new 体现了名词化。make new again = renew，用 make + 形容词 + again 替代动词。

examples.en: A fresh coat of paint made the old house look new again inside and out.
examples.zh: 刷了一层新油漆让老房子里里外外看起来焕然一新。

examples.en: A fresh layer of pigment made the antiquated dwelling appear renewed throughout.
examples.zh: 刷了一层新油漆让老房子里里外外看起来焕然一新。

basic_explanation: 用 go back to normal 替代 normalize/return to normal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 normal 是常态形容词。
ogden_principle: normal 体现了名词化。go back to normal = normalize，用核心动词 go + back + to + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: After the storm, things slowly went back to normal in the quiet town.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，安静的小镇慢慢恢复了正常。

examples.en: Following the tempest, conditions gradually returned to normal in the tranquil municipality.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，安静的小镇慢慢恢复了正常。

basic_explanation: 用 make open 替代 open/unlock/unseal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 open 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: open 体现了名词化。make open = open/unlock，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Please make the window open to let in some fresh morning air.
examples.zh: 请打开窗户让早晨的新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: Please open the window to admit some fresh morning air.
examples.zh: 请打开窗户让早晨的新鲜空气进来。

basic_explanation: 用 go parallel to 替代 run alongside/parallel。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 parallel 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: parallel 体现了名词化。go parallel to = run alongside，用核心动词 go + 形容词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: The new road goes parallel to the old river all the way to the sea.
examples.zh: 新路与旧河平行，一直延伸到大海。

examples.en: The new road runs parallel to the ancient river all the way to the ocean.
examples.zh: 新路与旧河平行，一直延伸到大海。

basic_explanation: 用 go past 替代 pass/go beyond/exceed。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 past 是时间和空间形容词。
ogden_principle: past 体现了名词化。go past = pass/exceed，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: We went past the old church on our way to the town center.
examples.zh: 我们在去镇中心的路上经过了那座老教堂。

examples.en: We passed the ancient church on our journey to the town center.
examples.zh: 我们在去镇中心的路上经过了那座老教堂。

basic_explanation: 用 do physical work 替代 exercise/work out/labor。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 physical 是身体和物理形容词。
ogden_principle: physical 体现了名词化。do physical work = exercise，用 do + 形容词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: He does hard physical work all day lifting heavy boxes and moving things.
examples.zh: 他整天做着重体力活，搬沉重的箱子和移动物品。

examples.en: He performs strenuous manual labor all day lifting heavy containers and relocating objects.
examples.zh: 他整天做着重体力活，搬沉重的箱子和移动物品。

basic_explanation: 用 have political power 替代 be politically influential/govern。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 political 是社会领域形容词。
ogden_principle: political 体现了名词化。have political power = govern，用 have + 形容词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She has been in political office for more than twenty years now.
examples.zh: 她从政已经二十多年了。

examples.en: She has held political office for over two decades.
examples.zh: 她从政已经二十多年了。

basic_explanation: 用 be poor in 替代 lack/be deficient in/have little。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 poor 是经济状态形容词。
ogden_principle: poor 体现了名词化。be poor in = lack，用 be + 形容词 + in 替代动词。

examples.en: The land is poor in good things for growing strong healthy food plants.
examples.zh: 这片土地缺乏种植强壮健康粮食作物的好养分。

examples.en: The soil is deficient in nutrients for growing robust and healthy crops.
examples.zh: 这片土地缺乏种植强壮健康粮食作物的好养分。

basic_explanation: 用 make it possible to 替代 enable/allow/permit/facilitate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 possible 是可能性形容词。
ogden_principle: possible 体现了名词化。make it possible to = enable，用 make + it + 形容词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: The new bridge made it possible to go across the river in just five minutes.
examples.zh: 新桥使过河只需要五分钟。

examples.en: The new bridge enabled crossing the river in just five minutes.
examples.zh: 新桥使过河只需要五分钟。

basic_explanation: 用 be present at 替代 attend/witness/be there。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 present 是存在形容词。
ogden_principle: present 体现了名词化。be present at = attend，用 be + 形容词 + at 替代动词。

examples.en: All the family were present at the wedding in the little church by the sea.
examples.zh: 全家人都出席了海边小教堂的婚礼。

examples.en: All the family attended the nuptials in the small chapel by the ocean.
examples.zh: 全家人都出席了海边小教堂的婚礼。

basic_explanation: 用 keep private 替代 keep secret/confidential/not share。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 private 是隐私形容词。
ogden_principle: private 体现了名词化。keep private = keep secret，用 keep + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Please keep this information private and do not give it to anyone else.
examples.zh: 请对此信息保密，不要告诉其他任何人。

examples.en: Please keep this information confidential and do not disclose it to anyone.
examples.zh: 请对此信息保密，不要告诉其他任何人。

basic_explanation: 用 it is probable that 替代 probably/likely/may happen。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 probable 是概率形容词。
ogden_principle: probable 体现了名词化。it is probable that = probably，用 it + be + 形容词 + that 替代副词。

examples.en: It is probable that we will get rain before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 我们很可能在周末前会迎来降雨。

examples.en: It is likely that we will receive precipitation before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 我们很可能在周末前会迎来降雨。

basic_explanation: 用 be quick to 替代 quickly do/respond rapidly/be swift。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 quick 是速度形容词。
ogden_principle: quick 体现了名词化。be quick to = quickly do，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代副词结构。

examples.en: She was quick to give help when she saw the old man fall down.
examples.zh: 她看到老人摔倒时迅速伸出援手。

examples.en: She promptly offered assistance when she witnessed the elderly gentleman tumble.
examples.zh: 她看到老人摔倒时迅速伸出援手。

basic_explanation: 用 keep quiet 替代 be quiet/silence/hush。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 quiet 是声音状态形容词。
ogden_principle: quiet 体现了名词化。keep quiet = be quiet，用 keep + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Please keep quiet in the library so others can read and study well.
examples.zh: 在图书馆请保持安静，以便其他人能好好读书学习。

examples.en: Please remain silent in the library so others can read and study effectively.
examples.zh: 在图书馆请保持安静，以便其他人能好好读书学习。

basic_explanation: 用 get ready for 替代 prepare/ready oneself/make preparations。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ready 是预备状态形容词。
ogden_principle: ready 体现了名词化。get ready for = prepare，用核心动词 get + 形容词 + for 替代动词。

examples.en: Get ready for the long trip because we are leaving early in the morning.
examples.zh: 为长途旅行做好准备，我们一早就出发。

examples.en: Prepare for the extended journey because we are departing early in the morning.
examples.zh: 为长途旅行做好准备，我们一早就出发。

basic_explanation: 用 go red 替代 turn red/blush/redden。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 red 是基础颜色形容词。
ogden_principle: red 体现了名词化。go red = blush/redden，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Her face went red when she had to get up and speak to the crowd.
examples.zh: 她不得不站起来对人群讲话时脸红了起来。

examples.en: Her countenance flushed when she had to rise and address the assembly.
examples.zh: 她不得不站起来对人群讲话时脸红了起来。

basic_explanation: 用 keep regular 替代 regularize/maintain regularity。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 regular 是频率形容词。
ogden_principle: regular 体现了名词化。keep regular = maintain regularity，用 keep + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Keep regular hours for going to bed and getting up every day.
examples.zh: 每天保持规律的睡觉和起床时间。

examples.en: Maintain consistent hours for retiring and rising each day.
examples.zh: 每天保持规律的睡觉和起床时间。

basic_explanation: 用 be responsible for 替代 oversee/manage/be in charge of。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 responsible 是责任形容词。
ogden_principle: responsible 体现了名词化。be responsible for = manage/oversee，用 be + 形容词 + for 替代动词。

examples.en: She is responsible for the care of all the animals on the farm.
examples.zh: 她负责照料农场上的所有动物。

examples.en: She is in charge of the care of all the livestock on the agricultural establishment.
examples.zh: 她负责照料农场上的所有动物。

basic_explanation: 用 make right 替代 correct/fix/rectify。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 right 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: right 体现了名词化。make right = correct/fix，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Please make right the mistakes in the letter before you send it out.
examples.zh: 寄信之前请把信中的错误改正过来。

examples.en: Please correct the errors in the correspondence before you dispatch it.
examples.zh: 寄信之前请把信中的错误改正过来。

basic_explanation: 用 go round 替代 circle/rotate/encircle。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 round 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: round 体现了名词化。go round = circle/rotate，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The earth goes round the sun once every full year of time.
examples.zh: 地球每整整一年绕太阳转一圈。

examples.en: The planet revolves around the solar body once every complete calendar year.
examples.zh: 地球每整整一年绕太阳转一圈。

basic_explanation: 用 be the same as 替代 be identical/equal/match。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 same 是比较形容词。
ogden_principle: same 体现了名词化。be the same as = match/equal，用 be + 形容词 + as 替代动词。

examples.en: Your new dress is almost the same as the one I saw in the window.
examples.zh: 你的新裙子几乎和我在橱窗里看到的那条一样。

examples.en: Your new garment is nearly identical to the one I observed in the display.
examples.zh: 你的新裙子几乎和我在橱窗里看到的那条一样。

basic_explanation: 用 come second 替代 be second/runner-up/follow。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 second 是顺序形容词。
ogden_principle: second 体现了名词化。come second = be second，用核心动词 come + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: She came second in the race but was still very pleased with her time.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中得了第二名，但对自己的成绩仍然很满意。

examples.en: She finished second in the competition but was still very satisfied with her performance.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中得了第二名，但对自己的成绩仍然很满意。

basic_explanation: 用 keep separate from 替代 separate/isolate/divide。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 separate 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: separate 体现了名词化。keep separate from = separate/isolate，用 keep + 形容词 + from 替代动词。

examples.en: Keep the clean things separate from the dirty ones to stop the spread of illness.
examples.zh: 把干净的和脏的东西分开以防疾病传播。

examples.en: Keep the clean items isolated from the soiled ones to prevent the spread of disease.
examples.zh: 把干净的和脏的东西分开以防疾病传播。

basic_explanation: 用 be serious about 替代 take seriously/be committed to。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 serious 是态度形容词。
ogden_principle: serious 体现了名词化。be serious about = take seriously，用 be + 形容词 + about 替代动词短语。

examples.en: He is very serious about his work and never misses a day at the office.
examples.zh: 他对工作非常认真，从不缺勤一天。

examples.en: He is very committed to his occupation and never misses a day at the workplace.
examples.zh: 他对工作非常认真，从不缺勤一天。

basic_explanation: 用 make sharp 替代 sharpen/hone/whet。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sharp 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: sharp 体现了名词化。make sharp = sharpen，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the knife sharp before you start to cut up the meat for dinner.
examples.zh: 在开始切晚餐的肉之前把刀磨锋利。

examples.en: Sharpen the blade before you begin to cut the meat for the evening meal.
examples.zh: 在开始切晚餐的肉之前把刀磨锋利。

basic_explanation: 用 make smooth 替代 smooth/even out/polish。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 smooth 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: smooth 体现了名词化。make smooth = smooth/polish，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the rough wood smooth with paper before you put paint on it.
examples.zh: 在上漆之前用砂纸把粗糙的木头打磨光滑。

examples.en: Smooth the rough timber with abrasive material before you apply paint to it.
examples.zh: 在上漆之前用砂纸把粗糙的木头打磨光滑。

basic_explanation: 用 make sticky 替代 stick/adhere/glue。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sticky 是物理性质形容词。
ogden_principle: sticky 体现了名词化。make sticky = stick/adhere，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The sweet sugar made her fingers sticky and hard to get clean again.
examples.zh: 甜糖让她的手指变得黏糊糊的，很难再弄干净。

examples.en: The sweet sugar rendered her fingers adhesive and difficult to clean.
examples.zh: 甜糖让她的手指变得黏糊糊的，很难再弄干净。

basic_explanation: 用 make stiff 替代 stiffen/rigidify/harden。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 stiff 是柔性形容词。
ogden_principle: stiff 体现了名词化。make stiff = stiffen，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The cold made the wet cloth as stiff as a board overnight.
examples.zh: 寒冷使湿布一夜之间变得像板子一样僵硬。

examples.en: The frigid temperature rendered the wet fabric as rigid as a plank overnight.
examples.zh: 寒冷使湿布一夜之间变得像板子一样僵硬。

basic_explanation: 用 make straight 替代 straighten/align/rectify。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 straight 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: straight 体现了名词化。make straight = straighten，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the picture straight on the wall because it is hanging to one side.
examples.zh: 把墙上挂的画摆正，因为它歪到一边了。

examples.en: Straighten the picture on the wall because it is tilting to one side.
examples.zh: 把墙上挂的画摆正，因为它歪到一边了。

basic_explanation: 用 make strong 替代 strengthen/fortify/reinforce。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 strong 是力量形容词。
ogden_principle: strong 体现了名词化。make strong = strengthen，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Good food and plenty of exercise will make your body strong and healthy.
examples.zh: 好的食物和充足的锻炼会让你的身体强壮又健康。

examples.en: Nutritious food and ample exercise will make your physique robust and healthy.
examples.zh: 好的食物和充足的锻炼会让你的身体强壮又健康。

basic_explanation: 用 come to a sudden stop 替代 stop suddenly/halt abruptly。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sudden 是突发性形容词。
ogden_principle: sudden 体现了名词化。come to a sudden stop = stop suddenly，用核心动词 come + to + 形容词 + 名词替代副词结构。

examples.en: The car came to a sudden stop when the dog ran into the road.
examples.zh: 一只狗跑进马路时汽车猛地停了下来。

examples.en: The automobile came to an abrupt halt when the canine darted into the thoroughfare.
examples.zh: 一只狗跑进马路时汽车猛地停了下来。

basic_explanation: 用 make sweet 替代 sweeten/add sugar。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sweet 是味觉形容词。
ogden_principle: sweet 体现了名词化。make sweet = sweeten，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Put a little sugar in the tea to make it sweet enough to drink.
examples.zh: 在茶里放一点糖让它够甜好喝。

examples.en: Add a small amount of sugar to the tea to sweeten it sufficiently for drinking.
examples.zh: 在茶里放一点糖让它够甜好喝。

basic_explanation: 用 grow tall 替代 become tall/heighten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tall 是高度形容词。
ogden_principle: tall 体现了名词化。grow tall = become tall，用 grow + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The young tree grew tall and strong in the good earth by the river.
examples.zh: 小树在河边的沃土里长得又高又壮。

examples.en: The sapling grew tall and robust in the fertile soil adjacent to the waterway.
examples.zh: 小树在河边的沃土里长得又高又壮。

basic_explanation: 用 make thick 替代 thicken/densify。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 thick 是厚度和浓度形容词。
ogden_principle: thick 体现了名词化。make thick = thicken，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Put more flour in the soup to make it thick and rich for the meal.
examples.zh: 在汤里多加点面粉让它变得浓稠可口。

examples.en: Add more flour to the broth to thicken it and make it rich for the repast.
examples.zh: 在汤里多加点面粉让它变得浓稠可口。

basic_explanation: 用 make tight 替代 tighten/secures/fasten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tight 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: tight 体现了名词化。make tight = tighten，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the top of the bottle tight so the water does not come out.
examples.zh: 把瓶盖拧紧以免水漏出来。

examples.en: Tighten the cap of the bottle so the liquid does not leak out.
examples.zh: 把瓶盖拧紧以免水漏出来。

basic_explanation: 用 get tired 替代 become tired/fatigue。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 tired 是能量状态形容词。
ogden_principle: tired 体现了名词化。get tired = become tired，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: After the long walk up the high hill, everyone got very tired and needed a rest.
examples.zh: 走了很长的山路后，大家都很累了需要休息。

examples.en: After the extended hike up the steep elevation, everyone became exhausted and needed rest.
examples.zh: 走了很长的山路后，大家都很累了需要休息。

basic_explanation: 用 come true 替代 become real/actualize/fulfill。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 true 是真实性形容词。
ogden_principle: true 体现了名词化。come true = become real，用核心动词 come + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: All her hopes and dreams came true when she got the new job in the city.
examples.zh: 她在城里找到新工作时，所有的希望和梦想都成真了。

examples.en: All her aspirations and dreams materialized when she obtained the new position in the metropolis.
examples.zh: 她在城里找到新工作时，所有的希望和梦想都成真了。

basic_explanation: 用 get violent 替代 become violent/aggressive。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 violent 是强度形容词。
ogden_principle: violent 体现了名词化。get violent = become violent，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The storm got violent in the night and took down trees and power lines.
examples.zh: 暴风雨在夜间变得猛烈，刮倒了树木和电线。

examples.en: The tempest became violent during the night and felled trees and power lines.
examples.zh: 暴风雨在夜间变得猛烈，刮倒了树木和电线。

basic_explanation: 用 keep waiting 替代 make wait/delay/hold up。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 waiting 是状态形容词。
ogden_principle: waiting 体现了名词化。keep waiting = delay，用 keep + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: I am sorry to keep you waiting for so long at the station for me.
examples.zh: 很抱歉让你在车站等我等了这么久。

examples.en: I apologize for making you wait for such a long time at the station.
examples.zh: 很抱歉让你在车站等我等了这么久。

basic_explanation: 用 make warm 替代 warm/heat up。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 warm 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: warm 体现了名词化。make warm = warm/heat，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the soup warm on the fire before we sit down to eat together.
examples.zh: 在我们坐下来一起吃饭之前把汤在火上热一热。

examples.en: Warm the soup over the flame before we sit down to dine together.
examples.zh: 在我们坐下来一起吃饭之前把汤在火上热一热。

basic_explanation: 用 get wet 替代 become wet/moisten/dampen。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wet 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: wet 体现了名词化。get wet = become wet，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: We got wet in the sudden rain because we had no umbrella with us.
examples.zh: 我们在突如其来的大雨中被淋湿了，因为我们没带伞。

examples.en: We became drenched in the sudden precipitation because we had no umbrella.
examples.zh: 我们在突如其来的大雨中被淋湿了，因为我们没带伞。

basic_explanation: 用 make wide 替代 widen/broaden/expand。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wide 是宽度形容词。
ogden_principle: wide 体现了名词化。make wide = widen，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: They made the narrow road wide so two cars could go past at the same time.
examples.zh: 他们把窄路拓宽，让两辆车能同时通过。

examples.en: They widened the narrow road so two vehicles could pass simultaneously.
examples.zh: 他们把窄路拓宽，让两辆车能同时通过。

basic_explanation: 用 be wise to 替代 be prudent/sensible to。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wise 是智力形容词。
ogden_principle: wise 体现了名词化。be wise to = be prudent to，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: It is wise to get some good advice before making a great decision.
examples.zh: 做重大决定之前听取一些好的建议是明智的。

examples.en: It is prudent to seek sound advice before making a significant decision.
examples.zh: 做重大决定之前听取一些好的建议是明智的。

basic_explanation: 用 go yellow 替代 turn yellow/yellowing。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 yellow 是基础颜色形容词。
ogden_principle: yellow 体现了名词化。go yellow = turn yellow，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The old paper had gone yellow with age and was hard to read anymore.
examples.zh: 旧纸张因年代久远而泛黄，已经很难读了。

examples.en: The aged document had yellowed with time and was difficult to read.
examples.zh: 旧纸张因年代久远而泛黄，已经很难读了。

basic_explanation: 用 keep young 替代 stay young/maintain youth。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 young 是年龄形容词。
ogden_principle: young 体现了名词化。keep young = stay young，用 keep + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: A happy heart and a good life help to keep you young and full of joy.
examples.zh: 快乐的心和良好的生活有助于让你保持年轻和充满喜悦。

examples.en: A joyful heart and a good lifestyle help to keep you youthful and full of happiness.
examples.zh: 快乐的心和良好的生活有助于让你保持年轻和充满喜悦。

basic_explanation: 用 keep awake 替代 stay awake/remain alert。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 awake 是意识状态形容词。
ogden_principle: awake 体现了名词化。keep awake = stay awake，用 keep + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The loud noise from the street kept me awake all through the night.
examples.zh: 街上的噪音让我整夜都醒着。

examples.en: The loud noise from the street kept me conscious throughout the night.
examples.zh: 街上的噪音让我整夜都醒着。

basic_explanation: 用 go bad 替代 spoil/rot/decay。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bad 是最通用的负面评价形容词。
ogden_principle: bad 体现了名词化。go bad = spoil/rot，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The food went bad in the hot sun and could not be eaten anymore.
examples.zh: 食物在烈日下变质了，不能再吃了。

examples.en: The food spoiled in the hot sun and could no longer be consumed.
examples.zh: 食物在烈日下变质了，不能再吃了。

basic_explanation: 用 make bent 替代 bend/curve/flex。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bent 是形状形容词。
ogden_principle: bent 体现了名词化。make bent = bend，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The strong wind made the young tree bent over to one side.
examples.zh: 强风把小树吹弯到了一边。

examples.en: The powerful wind bent the young tree over to one side.
examples.zh: 强风把小树吹弯到了一边。

basic_explanation: 用 have a bitter taste 替代 be bitter/acrid。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 bitter 是味觉形容词。
ogden_principle: bitter 体现了名词化。have a bitter taste = be bitter，用 have + 形容词 + 名词替代形容词结构。

examples.en: The medicine had a bitter taste that was hard to get down.
examples.zh: 这药有苦味，很难下咽。

examples.en: The medication had an acrid flavor that was difficult to swallow.
examples.zh: 这药有苦味，很难下咽。

basic_explanation: 用 go blue 替代 turn blue/sadden。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 blue 是颜色和情感形容词。
ogden_principle: blue 体现了名词化。go blue = turn blue，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The sky went dark blue as night came over the quiet little town.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临安静的小镇时，天空变成了深蓝色。

examples.en: The firmament turned dark azure as night fell over the quiet little town.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临安静的小镇时，天空变成了深蓝色。

basic_explanation: 用 make certain of 替代 verify/confirm/ensure。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 certain 是确定性形容词。
ogden_principle: certain 体现了名词化。make certain of = verify/confirm，用 make + 形容词 + of 替代动词。

examples.en: Make certain of the time of the train before you leave for the station.
examples.zh: 去车站之前先确认好火车的时间。

examples.en: Verify the departure time of the train before you leave for the station.
examples.zh: 去车站之前先确认好火车的时间。

basic_explanation: 用 get cold 替代 become cold/chill/freeze。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cold 是温度形容词。
ogden_principle: cold 体现了名词化。get cold = become cold，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Put on your warm coat before you go out and get cold in the snow.
examples.zh: 穿上暖和外衣再出去，免得在雪地里冻着。

examples.en: Don your warm coat before you venture out and become chilled in the snow.
examples.zh: 穿上暖和外衣再出去，免得在雪地里冻着。

basic_explanation: 用 make complete 替代 complete/finish/finalize。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 complete 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: complete 体现了名词化。make complete = complete/finish，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the work complete before you go home at the end of the day.
examples.zh: 在一天结束回家之前把工作做完。

examples.en: Complete the task before you depart for home at the end of the day.
examples.zh: 在一天结束回家之前把工作做完。

basic_explanation: 用 be cruel to 替代 mistreat/abuse/torment。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 cruel 是道德评价形容词。
ogden_principle: cruel 体现了名词化。be cruel to = mistreat，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: It is wrong to be cruel to any living thing, great or small.
examples.zh: 残忍对待任何生物都是错误的，无论是大是小。

examples.en: It is immoral to be cruel to any living creature, whether large or small.
examples.zh: 残忍对待任何生物都是错误的，无论是大是小。

basic_explanation: 用 go dark 替代 darken/become dark/dim。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dark 是光线状态形容词。
ogden_principle: dark 体现了名词化。go dark = darken，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The room went dark when someone put out all the lights at once.
examples.zh: 有人一下子关掉所有灯后房间变黑了。

examples.en: The chamber darkened when someone extinguished all the lights simultaneously.
examples.zh: 有人一下子关掉所有灯后房间变黑了。

basic_explanation: 用 go dead 替代 die/perish/expire。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dead 是生命状态形容词。
ogden_principle: dead 体现了名词化。go dead = die，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The flowers went dead because no one gave them water for a week.
examples.zh: 花因为一周没人浇水而枯死了。

examples.en: The flowers died because no one watered them for a week.
examples.zh: 花因为一周没人浇水而枯死了。

basic_explanation: 用 be dear to 替代 be precious/valued/cherished。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dear 是情感和价值形容词。
ogden_principle: dear 体现了名词化。be dear to = be precious to，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: This old picture is very dear to me because my mother gave it to me.
examples.zh: 这张老照片对我来说很珍贵，因为它是我妈妈给我的。

examples.en: This old photograph is very precious to me because my mother gave it to me.
examples.zh: 这张老照片对我来说很珍贵，因为它是我妈妈给我的。

basic_explanation: 用 be delicate in 替代 be fragile/sensitive/fine。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 delicate 是精细度形容词。
ogden_principle: delicate 体现了名词化。be delicate in = be sensitive in，用 be + 形容词 + in 替代动词短语。

examples.en: Be delicate in your touch when you are working with the thin glass.
examples.zh: 在处理薄玻璃时动作要轻巧。
