examples.en: Be gentle in your touch when you are handling the thin glass.
examples.zh: 在处理薄玻璃时动作要轻巧。

basic_explanation: 用 be different from 替代 differ/contrast/vary。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 different 是比较形容词。
ogden_principle: different 体现了名词化。be different from = differ from，用 be + 形容词 + from 替代动词。

examples.en: This new plan is very different from the one we had before today.
examples.zh: 这个新计划和今天之前我们那个计划很不同。

examples.en: This new plan differs significantly from the one we had previously.
examples.zh: 这个新计划和今天之前我们那个计划很不同。

basic_explanation: 用 get dirty 替代 become dirty/soiled/foul。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dirty 是清洁状态形容词。
ogden_principle: dirty 体现了名词化。get dirty = become dirty，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Your hands got dirty from working in the garden all morning long.
examples.zh: 你在花园里干了一上午活，手弄脏了。

examples.en: Your hands became soiled from working in the garden all morning.
examples.zh: 你在花园里干了一上午活，手弄脏了。

basic_explanation: 用 make dry 替代 dry/dehydrate/desiccate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 dry 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: dry 体现了名词化。make dry = dry，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make your hands dry on the clean cloth before you sit at the table.
examples.zh: 上桌之前用干净的布把手擦干。

examples.en: Dry your hands on the clean cloth before you sit at the table.
examples.zh: 上桌之前用干净的布把手擦干。

basic_explanation: 用 be false to 替代 betray/deceive/mislead。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 false 是真实性形容词。
ogden_principle: false 体现了名词化。be false to = betray，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: It is wrong to be false to your friends and say things that are not true.
examples.zh: 对朋友不诚实、说假话是不对的。

examples.en: It is wrong to be dishonest with your friends and say things that are untrue.
examples.zh: 对朋友不诚实、说假话是不对的。

basic_explanation: 用 get feeble 替代 become weak/weaken/frail。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 feeble 是强度形容词。
ogden_principle: feeble 体现了名词化。get feeble = become weak，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The old man got feeble with age and needed help to go up the steps.
examples.zh: 老人因年迈变得虚弱，上台阶需要帮助。

examples.en: The elderly man became frail with age and required assistance to climb the steps.
examples.zh: 老人因年迈变得虚弱，上台阶需要帮助。

basic_explanation: 用 be female 替代 be feminine/of the female sex。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 female 是性别形容词。
ogden_principle: female 是不可替代的生物学基础形容词。Basic English 保留这类核心概念词。

examples.en: The female bird sits on the eggs to keep them warm and safe.
examples.zh: 雌鸟坐在蛋上让它们保持温暖和安全。

examples.en: The female avian incubates the eggs to keep them warm and protected.
examples.zh: 雌鸟坐在蛋上让它们保持温暖和安全。

basic_explanation: 用 be foolish to 替代 be unwise/silly/stupid。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 foolish 是智力评价形容词。
ogden_principle: foolish 体现了名词化。be foolish to = be unwise to，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: It would be foolish to go out in the storm without a good coat.
examples.zh: 不穿好外套就出去到暴风雨中是愚蠢的。

examples.en: It would be unwise to venture out in the tempest without proper attire.
examples.zh: 不穿好外套就出去到暴风雨中是愚蠢的。

basic_explanation: 用 in the future 替代 later/someday/eventually。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 future 是时间形容词。
ogden_principle: future 体现了名词化。in the future = later，用介词 + 形容词替代副词。

examples.en: We all hope for good things to come in the future years ahead.
examples.zh: 我们都希望在未来的岁月里有好事来临。

examples.en: We all hope for positive developments in the forthcoming years.
examples.zh: 我们都希望在未来的岁月里有好事来临。

basic_explanation: 用 go green 替代 turn green/become environmentally friendly。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 green 是颜色和环保形容词。
ogden_principle: green 体现了名词化。go green = become environmentally friendly，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: The fields went green again after the first spring rains came down.
examples.zh: 第一场春雨降临后田野又变绿了。

examples.en: The fields turned verdant again after the first spring rains descended.
examples.zh: 第一场春雨降临后田野又变绿了。

basic_explanation: 用 get ill 替代 become sick/fall ill。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 ill 是健康状态形容词。
ogden_principle: ill 体现了名词化。get ill = become sick，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: She got ill after eating the bad food and had to go to hospital.
examples.zh: 她吃了变质的食物后生病了，不得不住院。

examples.en: She became sick after consuming the spoiled food and had to go to hospital.
examples.zh: 她吃了变质的食物后生病了，不得不住院。

basic_explanation: 用 come last 替代 be last/finish last。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 last 是顺序形容词。
ogden_principle: last 体现了名词化。come last = be last，用核心动词 come + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: He came last in the race but was happy just to have taken part in it.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中跑了最后一名，但只要能参加他就很高兴了。

examples.en: He finished last in the competition but was content simply to have participated.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中跑了最后一名，但只要能参加他就很高兴了。

basic_explanation: 用 be late for 替代 miss the deadline/arrive after time。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 late 是时间遵守形容词。
ogden_principle: late 体现了名词化。be late for = miss，用 be + 形容词 + for 替代动词。

examples.en: Do not be late for the meeting or you will not get a seat.
examples.zh: 开会别迟到，否则你找不到座位。

examples.en: Do not arrive tardy for the meeting or you will not get a seat.
examples.zh: 开会别迟到，否则你找不到座位。

basic_explanation: 用 go left 替代 turn left/veer left。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 left 是方向形容词。
ogden_principle: left 体现了名词化。go left = turn left，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Go left at the end of the street and you will see the station there.
examples.zh: 在街的尽头左转，你就能看到车站。

examples.en: Turn left at the end of the street and you will see the station.
examples.zh: 在街的尽头左转，你就能看到车站。

basic_explanation: 用 make loose 替代 loosen/untie/unfasten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 loose 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: loose 体现了名词化。make loose = loosen，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the knot loose so you can get it open again without trouble.
examples.zh: 把结打松一点，这样你就能毫不费力地再解开它。

examples.en: Loosen the knot so you can untie it again without difficulty.
examples.zh: 把结打松一点，这样你就能毫不费力地再解开它。

basic_explanation: 用 give a loud cry 替代 shout/yell/scream。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 loud 是音量形容词。
ogden_principle: loud 体现了名词化。give a loud cry = shout，用 give + 形容词 + 名词替代动词。

examples.en: She gave a loud cry of joy when she saw her old friend at the door.
examples.zh: 她看到老朋友在门口时高兴地大叫了一声。

examples.en: She exclaimed loudly with joy when she saw her old friend at the entrance.
examples.zh: 她看到老朋友在门口时高兴地大叫了一声。

basic_explanation: 用 make low 替代 lower/reduce/decrease。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 low 是高度和程度形容词。
ogden_principle: low 体现了名词化。make low = lower，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the sound of the music low because the baby is sleeping now.
examples.zh: 把音乐声音调低，因为宝宝正在睡觉。

examples.en: Lower the volume of the music because the baby is sleeping now.
examples.zh: 把音乐声音调低，因为宝宝正在睡觉。

basic_explanation: 用 make mixed 替代 mix/blend/combine。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 mixed 是组合状态形容词。
ogden_principle: mixed 体现了名词化。make mixed = mix/blend，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: She made a mixed fruit drink with apples, oranges and sweet berries.
examples.zh: 她用苹果、橙子和甜浆果做了一杯混合果汁。

examples.en: She blended a fruit beverage with apples, oranges and sweet berries.
examples.zh: 她用苹果、橙子和甜浆果做了一杯混合果汁。

basic_explanation: 用 make narrow 替代 narrow/constrict/tighten。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 narrow 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: narrow 体现了名词化。make narrow = narrow，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The road was made narrow by the deep snow on both of its sides.
examples.zh: 路被两侧深深的积雪弄得变窄了。

examples.en: The road was narrowed by the deep snow on both sides.
examples.zh: 路被两侧深深的积雪弄得变窄了。

basic_explanation: 用 get old 替代 age/become old。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 old 是年龄形容词。
ogden_principle: old 体现了名词化。get old = age，用核心动词 get + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: We all get old in time, but a young heart keeps us happy.
examples.zh: 我们都会随着时间变老，但一颗年轻的心让我们快乐。

examples.en: We all age with time, but a youthful spirit keeps us happy.
examples.zh: 我们都会随着时间变老，但一颗年轻的心让我们快乐。

basic_explanation: 用 be opposite to 替代 oppose/contrast/contradict。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 opposite 是比较形容词。
ogden_principle: opposite 体现了名词化。be opposite to = oppose/contrast，用 be + 形容词 + to 替代动词。

examples.en: His ideas are completely opposite to mine on this important matter.
examples.zh: 在这个重要问题上他的想法和我的完全相反。

examples.en: His ideas completely contradict mine on this important issue.
examples.zh: 在这个重要问题上他的想法和我的完全相反。

basic_explanation: 用 make public 替代 publish/disclose/reveal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 public 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: public 体现了名词化。make public = publish/disclose，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: They made the news public in the paper for everyone to read today.
examples.zh: 他们今天在报纸上公开了这个消息让所有人阅读。

examples.en: They published the news in the paper for everyone to read today.
examples.zh: 他们今天在报纸上公开了这个消息让所有人阅读。

basic_explanation: 用 make rough 替代 roughen/coarsen。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 rough 是质地形容词。
ogden_principle: rough 体现了名词化。make rough = roughen，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The hard work made his hands rough and full of hard, dry skin.
examples.zh: 艰苦的劳作让他的手变得粗糙，满是又硬又干的皮肤。

examples.en: The strenuous labor made his hands rough and covered with calloused skin.
examples.zh: 艰苦的劳作让他的手变得粗糙，满是又硬又干的皮肤。

basic_explanation: 用 make sad 替代 sadden/depress/grieve。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 sad 是情感形容词。
ogden_principle: sad 体现了名词化。make sad = sadden，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The end of the story made everyone feel sad and quiet for a long time.
examples.zh: 故事的结局让每个人都感到悲伤，沉默了很久。

examples.en: The conclusion of the narrative saddened everyone for a long while.
examples.zh: 故事的结局让每个人都感到悲伤，沉默了很久。

basic_explanation: 用 keep safe 替代 protect/safeguard/secure。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 safe 是安全状态形容词。
ogden_principle: safe 体现了名词化。keep safe = protect/safeguard，用 keep + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Keep your important papers safe in a strong box that will not burn.
examples.zh: 把你的重要文件放进一个烧不坏的坚固盒子里好好保管。

examples.en: Store your important documents securely in a fireproof strongbox.
examples.zh: 把你的重要文件放进一个烧不坏的坚固盒子里好好保管。

basic_explanation: 用 keep secret 替代 hide/conceal/not reveal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 secret 可作形容词也可作名词。
ogden_principle: secret 体现了名词化。keep secret = hide/conceal，用 keep + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Can you keep a secret if I give you some very important news today?
examples.zh: 如果我今天告诉你一些非常重要的消息，你能保密吗？

examples.en: Can you keep confidential information if I share some very important news with you?
examples.zh: 如果我今天告诉你一些非常重要的消息，你能保密吗？

basic_explanation: 用 make short 替代 shorten/abbreviate/truncate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 short 是长度形容词。
ogden_principle: short 体现了名词化。make short = shorten，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the talk short because we all want to get home before dark.
examples.zh: 发言简短些，因为我们都想在天黑前到家。

examples.en: Shorten the speech because we all want to get home before dark.
examples.zh: 发言简短些，因为我们都想在天黑前到家。

basic_explanation: 用 keep shut 替代 keep closed/seal/close。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 shut 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: shut 体现了名词化。keep shut = keep closed，用 keep + 形容词替代动词短语。

examples.en: Keep the windows shut when the cold north wind is blowing outside.
examples.zh: 外面刮着寒冷的北风时把窗户关好。

examples.en: Keep the windows closed when the frigid north wind is blowing outside.
examples.zh: 外面刮着寒冷的北风时把窗户关好。

basic_explanation: 用 make simple 替代 simplify/streamline/clarify。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 simple 是复杂度形容词。
ogden_principle: simple 体现了名词化。make simple = simplify，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the instructions simple so that even a child can do the work.
examples.zh: 把说明写得简单点，让连小孩都能做这个工作。

examples.en: Simplify the instructions so that even a child can perform the task.
examples.zh: 把说明写得简单点，让连小孩都能做这个工作。

basic_explanation: 用 make slow 替代 slow down/decelerate/retard。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 slow 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: slow 体现了名词化。make slow = slow down，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The deep snow made our forward move slow and very hard going.
examples.zh: 深深的积雪使我们的前进变得缓慢而艰难。

examples.en: The deep snow slowed our progress and made it very difficult.
examples.zh: 深深的积雪使我们的前进变得缓慢而艰难。

basic_explanation: 用 make small 替代 reduce/shrink/minimize。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 small 是尺寸形容词。
ogden_principle: small 体现了名词化。make small = reduce/shrink，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the picture small so it will go into the space on the wall there.
examples.zh: 把画缩小一点，这样它就能放进墙上那个空间了。

examples.en: Reduce the picture so it will fit into the space on the wall.
examples.zh: 把画缩小一点，这样它就能放进墙上那个空间了。

basic_explanation: 用 make soft 替代 soften/cushion/mollify。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 soft 是硬度形容词。
ogden_principle: soft 体现了名词化。make soft = soften，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the butter soft before you put it in with the other things.
examples.zh: 把黄油弄软后再和其他东西放在一起。

examples.en: Soften the butter before you combine it with the other ingredients.
examples.zh: 把黄油弄软后再和其他东西放在一起。

basic_explanation: 用 make solid 替代 solidify/harden/congeal。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 solid 是物质状态形容词。
ogden_principle: solid 体现了名词化。make solid = solidify，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: The cold made the water solid and we could walk across it on foot.
examples.zh: 寒冷使水凝固成了固体，我们可以步行穿过它。

examples.en: The cold solidified the water and we could traverse it on foot.
examples.zh: 寒冷使水凝固成了固体，我们可以步行穿过它。

basic_explanation: 用 make special 替代 distinguish/single out/honor。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 special 是独特性形容词。
ogden_principle: special 体现了名词化。make special = distinguish/honor，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: We made the day special by having a party for all our best friends.
examples.zh: 我们为所有最好的朋友举办了派对，让这一天变得特别。

examples.en: We made the day special by hosting a celebration for all our closest friends.
examples.zh: 我们为所有最好的朋友举办了派对，让这一天变得特别。

basic_explanation: 用 seem strange to 替代 appear unusual/odd/peculiar。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 strange 是熟悉度形容词。
ogden_principle: strange 体现了名词化。seem strange to = appear unusual to，用 seem + 形容词 + to 替代动词短语。

examples.en: The new town seemed strange to us at first but we soon got used to it.
examples.zh: 新镇子起初对我们来说很陌生，但我们很快就习惯了。

examples.en: The new town appeared unfamiliar to us initially but we soon adapted.
examples.zh: 新镇子起初对我们来说很陌生，但我们很快就习惯了。

basic_explanation: 用 make thin 替代 thin/dilute/attenuate。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 thin 可作形容词也可作动词。
ogden_principle: thin 体现了名词化。make thin = thin/dilute，用 make + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Make the soup thin with more water if it is too thick to drink.
examples.zh: 如果汤太稠了喝不了就加点水把它弄稀。

examples.en: Dilute the soup with more water if it is too thick to consume.
examples.zh: 如果汤太稠了喝不了就加点水把它弄稀。

basic_explanation: 用 go white 替代 turn white/pale/blanch。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 white 是基础颜色形容词。
ogden_principle: white 体现了名词化。go white = turn white/pale，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Her face went white with fear when she heard the bad news come.
examples.zh: 听到坏消息传来时她吓得脸色发白。

examples.en: Her countenance paled with terror when she heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 听到坏消息传来时她吓得脸色发白。

basic_explanation: 用 go wrong 替代 malfunction/err/fail。
standard_explanation: 标准英语中 wrong 是最通用的错误形容词。
ogden_principle: wrong 体现了名词化。go wrong = malfunction/err，用核心动词 go + 形容词替代动词。

examples.en: Something went wrong with the machine and it stopped working all at once.
examples.zh: 机器出了故障，一下子停止运转了。

examples.en: Something malfunctioned in the machine and it ceased operating suddenly.
examples.zh: 机器出了故障，一下子停止运转了。
